title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Data Engineer

London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office

Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property.

We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents.

We’re looking for someone to own that foundation.

The opportunity

You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have.

The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform.

There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable.

  • Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled.

  • Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data.

  • Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context. Preserve source provenance, geographic scope and effective dates so consumers can distinguish current information from historical or superseded guidance.

  • Design for international expansion. Build shared models and ingestion patterns that accommodate differences in property markets, tax systems and regulation. When we expand geographies, we want to go at speed, without rebuilding the platform.

  • Own reliability throughout the lifecycle. Build monitoring, validation and recovery into ingestion, transformation, storage and serving. Know what is stale, missing or incorrect, understand the customer impact and address the root cause.

  • Set the technical direction and deliver it. Make clear trade-offs between immediate product needs and long-term architecture. Ship useful improvements early, document decisions and help shape the standards and future team needed to support the platform.

What you bring

  • Experience owning substantial data systems. You’ve designed, built and operated production data platforms or major parts of them, and can explain the architectural decisions you made and their consequences.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals. You bring strong SQL, data modelling and production programming skills, with practical experience in orchestration, testing, deployment and operating reliable pipelines.

  • Judgment about the data itself. You can evaluate whether a source is fit for a particular use, reconcile inconsistent information and make uncertainty or gaps visible to downstream consumers.

  • Experience with messy external sources. You’ve handled inconsistent formats, changing schemas, incomplete records, rate limits and integration failures. You’re comfortable working beyond clean, well-documented APIs.

  • A product mindset. You care about the decisions your data supports. You can work with domain experts and product engineers to translate an ambiguous need into a useful data product.

  • Architectural ownership. You can review an existing system, establish a direction and deliver improvements incrementally. You understand access controls, privacy and the responsibilities that come with combining customer and external data.

  • Clear communication and initiative. You surface problems early, write down decisions and challenge assumptions constructively. You’re comfortable making progress without a fully specified ticket.

Bonus

  • Experience building data foundations for AI products, including retrieval, document processing or evaluating the quality of information supplied to agents.

  • Experience modelling policy or regulatory information, including versioning and effective dates.

  • Experience with property, financial services, geospatial data or international datasets.

  • Familiarity with GCP, where we run our infrastructure, and experience working alongside backend engineering teams.

  • Experience establishing data standards or helping build a data team.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You just want to keep the pipelines running. You’ll need to care about which data we use, whether it can be trusted and how it improves the decisions our products support.

  • You want a fully specified architecture to implement. We need someone who can assess what exists, challenge assumptions and take ownership of the technical direction.

  • You only want to work with clean, structured data. Important information arrives through documents, policy announcements and inconsistent external sources. Making it usable is part of the job.

  • You want to stay removed from the product or domain. You’ll work closely with product engineers and property experts. Understanding what the data means and how it is used is essential.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own a data platform central to GetGround’s next phase of product development.

  • Turn deep property expertise into intelligence that helps real investors.

  • Work on challenging problems across customer data, property information, AI and regulated services.

  • Shape the architecture for international expansion and help build our future data organisation.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

  • 22 nationalities represented across offices in 5 countries

title: Data Scientist Internship
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between infrastructure, backend, and frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership, and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).
  • Benchmark quality, reliability, and cost/latency, and document trade-offs.
  • Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

title: Diesel Mechanic
descriptionHtml:

  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements.

  • Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids.

Qualifications

  • GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics.

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein


Deine Aufgaben als Digital Media Sales & Account Manager (m/w)

    ... und du pflegst deine Pipeline und deinen Forecast so, dass wir uns darauf gemeinsam verlassen können

Dein Profil


Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifiziert und Lust auf richtig guten Mediavertrieb hast, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Mediavertrieb mit, zum Beispiel bei einem Vermarkter, Publisher, einer Plattform oder auf Agenturseite

title: Director Enterprise Planning and Transformation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Own the enterprise planning framework that translates company vision and strategy, through commercial growth and customer demand, into aligned product development and operational plans. Bring together Commercial, Engineering, Programmes, Operations and Finance to create one funded, resourced and governed business plan. Lead the transformation, process architecture and resilience needed to deliver it.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

Enterprise planning — primary accountability

  • Vision and strategy into plans: Translate strategic objectives into a 3–5-year enterprise roadmap, annual business plan and rolling 36-month demand and delivery plan. Define planning assumptions, milestones, owners and dependencies across functions and sites.
  • Commercial demand and growth: Work with Commercial to translate customer needs, contracts, pipeline and growth opportunities into demand scenarios by product, configuration, launch date and site. Distinguish committed demand from probable and aspirational growth, making assumptions and confidence explicit.
  • Product development alignment: Integrate the product roadmap, development priorities, engineering resources, qualification and test campaigns, configuration changes and industrialisation milestones. Reconcile customer needs and market timing with product readiness, including development demand competing with production capacity.
  • Operations and capacity: Translate launch demand into rocket, subsystem, supplier, manufacturing, integration, test and logistics requirements. Align workforce, equipment, inventory, footprint and launch infrastructure plans; expose constraints and define interventions, owners and required-by dates.
  • Financial reconciliation and choices: With Finance, reconcile revenue, cost, cash, working capital and capital investment. Quantify demand, product and capacity scenarios; recommend prioritisation, make/buy, investment and timing decisions that balance growth, readiness and affordability.
  • SIOP and execution linkage: Implement monthly Demand Review, Supply and Capacity Review, Integrated Reconciliation and Executive SIOP. Connect 0–6-month execution, 6–18-month capacity and 18–36-month strategic planning to the longer-term roadmap. Baseline approved commitments, control changes and track decisions into delivery.

Transformation and enterprise governance

  • Transformation and process architecture: Lead the transformation portfolio required to execute the enterprise plan. Own end-to-end business process architecture, owners, interfaces and controls, aligned with the QMS and digital roadmap. Track milestones, adoption and verified benefits.
  • Risk, continuity and governance: Own business risk and continuity frameworks, impact assessments, recovery priorities and exercises. Establish weekly delivery visibility, monthly SIOP, quarterly enterprise/investment reviews and annual Board planning inputs, with clear escalation, decisions and action closure.

Required implementation outputs

  • Mobilise the framework: Agree the executive sponsor, process owners, calendar, common definitions, data sources, planning horizons, change rules and decision rights. Launch SIOP in parallel with development of the wider framework.
  • Establish the first integrated plan: Lead a six-week mobilisation, targeting the first Demand Review within two weeks. Deliver a 36-month demand/launch plan, aligned development and rocket production plans, global capacity model, constraint and investment roadmap, and executive dashboard.
  • Make it executable: Secure functional ownership of assumptions and actions; present gaps, scenarios and recommendations for executive approval. Embed the plan in budgets, resource commitments and functional delivery reviews, with continuity gaps and recovery actions tracked.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Enterprise planning: Senior experience building integrated business planning or SIOP in aerospace, space or complex manufacturing. Proven ability to connect strategy, commercial growth, product development, operations and financial plans across functions and sites.
  • Transformation and resilience: Track record in cross-functional transformation, business process architecture, governance and business continuity, including impact assessments, recovery planning and exercises.
  • Judgement and leadership: Strong scenario modelling, capacity planning and financial understanding. Able to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions and turn complex choices into clear decisions and accountable delivery. Relevant qualification or equivalent experience.
  • AI and digital capability — required: Demonstrable practical use of AI and automation to improve departmental efficiency, analysis or planning, with measurable results. Experience connecting planning information across enterprise systems and maintaining reliable data and appropriate controls.

Aim radically high • Deliver, no excuses • Act with trust and integrity • Mission first, always

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance
  • Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.         

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

Data Protection
We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. For detailed information on how your data is processed, including your rights, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Disclaimer
Isar Aerospace SE is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. title: Director of International Product
descriptionHtml:
About Lyra
Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

Lyra is looking for a visionary and strategic Director, International Product to lead and scale our global mental health offerings. As Lyra grows around the world, you’ll shape how we deliver high-quality, culturally relevant care to members, providers, and employers in every market we serve.

You’ll serve as the connective tissue between our global commercial ambitions and technical execution, guiding multiple simultaneous initiatives and building a platform-first, repeatable engine for international growth. Working alongside senior leadership, you’ll own the strategic vision, delivery, and performance of the international product suite.

The leaders who thrive in this role pair high standards with real care for the people around them. They build strong relationships across the organization, earn influence through trust and clarity, and bring steady, energizing leadership to their teams, especially when the path ahead is uncertain


What You'll Do:
  • Global Product Vision & Strategy: Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for Lyra’s international product suite, grounded in market analysis, competitive insight, and firsthand understanding of the members, providers, and clients we serve in each region. Synthesize global market signals into a clear point of view on where to invest for the greatest impact for global employers.
  • Product Scope & Ownership: Hold full lifecycle responsibility for the scoping, development, and delivery of member experiences and the underlying platform infrastructure across four major product lines: International Lyra Workforce Mental Health (WFMH), Global Lyra Wellbeing, 10 Local Lyra Wellbeing products, and other product surface areas as needed.
  • Platform-First Scale: Lead the evolution of our international offerings onto a unified global platform, with automated workflows that make each new client launch faster and more repeatable than the last. Champion the localization of core capabilities, including billing, eligibility, and provider management, so they flex gracefully across markets.
  • Roadmap Stewardship: Balance the needs of today’s clients with durable, long-term platform investments. Make clear, well-reasoned tradeoffs, explain the “why” behind them in a way that brings people along, and have the conviction to say “not yet” when that’s what best serves members and the business.
  • Leadership & Team Development: Build and lead the International Product team. Hire and grow exceptional people, including leaders whose strengths go beyond your own, and invest in their development through candid, caring feedback and meaningful ownership. Your success is measured by how well your team thrives: clearing the path, providing context, and creating the conditions for others to do their best work.
  • Business Ownership & Resourcing: Create and manage the annual budget for International Product. Assess resourcing needs and build compelling business cases to secure the investment needed to reach ambitious growth targets.
  • Cost-to-Serve & Performance Insight: Partner with the Data organization to build a single, trusted view of international performance, giving leadership clear visibility into margins, ROI, and utilization. Define and track the product metrics that measure success, and identify opportunities to streamline and automate so global products are built for long-term profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the central connector across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Clinical Governance, Legal, and Compliance. Build trusted relationships across regions and time zones, including in our local operations work toward win-win outcomes amid competing priorities, and ensure clinical quality and local regulatory requirements are built into the product lifecycle from the start.
  • Go-To-Market Partnership: Act as a trusted partner to Go-To-Market and Client Services teams. Serve as the product voice in high-stakes, C-level client conversations and complex RFPs, bringing the technical and clinical confidence that helps Lyra win and retain large-scale global contracts.
  • AI-Enabled Product Excellence: Maintain a high bar for product craft and apply AI with purpose, both in our products, where it can meaningfully expand access and improve care, and in how we work. Model how AI can accelerate research, synthesis, planning, and execution, and help your team adopt tools and practices that drive efficiency, effectiveness, and happiness.

    • What You'll Bring:
  • Experience: Several years in product management, strategy, or technical operations.
  • Leadership: Several years of people leadership, with a track record of building strong teams and coaching talent to grow beyond their current roles.
  • Global Product Expertise: Experience launching and scaling products across multiple countries, including localizing for language, culture, and care norms, and navigating regional privacy and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, data residency). A natural instinct to design for local context, informed by real cultural fluency.
  • Platform & Enterprise Architecture: Deep understanding of bringing multiple systems together onto a unified global platform and reducing the effort required for each new client launch.
  • Commercial & Financial Acumen: Advanced skills in multivariable planning, budget ownership, and resource forecasting in a complex, matrixed environment. You think like a business owner and use data on product health, margin, ROI, and utilization to guide strategy.
  • Executive Influence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can distill complexity into a crisp narrative, write a document that drives a decision, and adapt your message for engineers, clinicians, and C-level executives alike. A demonstrated track record of influencing senior leaders and key external stakeholders through credibility and trust, along with strong negotiation skills.
  • High Performance under Complexity: Ability to analyze changing, multivariable situations and set objectives with high impact on company goals. You make sound calls with incomplete information, move comfortably between the details and the big picture, keep momentum when plans shift, and stay composed and solutions-oriented when headwinds arise.
  • Practical AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI to meaningfully accelerate your own work and your team’s, with the discernment to know where it adds real value.
  • Culture & Psychological Safety: A model of Lyra’s values who fosters psychological safety across the team, welcomes nuanced feedback, and makes it safe for team members to voice differing opinions. You hold strong opinions loosely, change your mind when the evidence warrants, and share credit freely.
  • Mission & People Focus: A passion for Lyra’s mission. Your curiosity and empathy come naturally: they show up in the questions you ask, the time you spend with members, providers, and clients, and the products you build as a result.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) required; MBA or equivalent professional experience preferred.

title: Director of Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like.

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system.


What This Role Is Not:

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title.


What You Will Work On:


Technical Leadership

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1


Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.


Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

title: Director, Strategic Intelligence

title: Electrical Engineer (Tooling)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - N3XT (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Embedded Engineer brings N3XT’s hardware to life. You write firmware for sensor front-ends, payload controllers, power systems and communication modules, bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, and build the low-level interfaces the application software depends on.

Prototypes in N3XT move fast. A board designed a few weeks ago lands on your bench, runs your firmware the same day and is on the test field by the end of the week. You sit between hardware and software and keep both sides honest about timing, power and interfaces.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop firmware in C and C++ for microcontrollers and SoCs (e.g. STM32, NXP i.MX, Xilinx Zynq), bare-metal or on an RTOS.

  • Bring up new boards together with the hardware engineers: drivers, peripherals, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscope and logic analyser.

  • Implement communication interfaces and protocols: CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, USB and radio links.

  • Integrate embedded Linux on compute modules: bootloader, kernel configuration, device tree and drivers.

  • Write real-time firmware for sensor acquisition and control, with attention to timing, power and reliability.

  • Define and document the interfaces to the application software and to the autopilot.

  • Support field tests and diagnose problems directly on the hardware.

  • Document firmware and interfaces for handover to line engineering.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics or a related field.

  • At least three years of embedded software development on systems that shipped or were used in the field.

  • Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software.

  • Strong C and C++ for resource-constrained systems; experience with an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr.

  • Hands-on board bring-up and hardware debugging; fluent reading of schematics and datasheets.

  • Embedded Linux experience with Yocto, Buildroot or a comparable build system.

  • Version control, code review and automated testing for firmware.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Business-fluent English. German is a strong advantage.

Strong Advantage:

  • Defence experience, or a working understanding of how armed forces use unmanned systems and what is being built for them right now.

  • FPGA development (VHDL or Verilog) or software-defined radio work.

  • Sensor or RF front-end firmware for radar, electronic warfare or signal intelligence systems.

  • PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, DroneCAN.

  • Secure boot, encryption and anti-tamper measures.

  • Development under DO-178C, IEC 61508 or comparable safety standards.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

title: Embedded Software Engineer (NWB)
descriptionHtml:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!
We’re looking for an Embedded Software Engineer who thrives close to the hardware and enjoys building high-performance, reliable firmware for DSP architecture and microcontrollers (e.g., RISC V and Arm Cortex M/A). You’ll design and implement real-time embedded software, optimize compute-heavy pipelines, and collaborate with hardware and systems teams to bring products from concept to production. This role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture/design, low-level firmware, and performance tuning—especially where latency, throughput, power, and determinism matter.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for DSP cores and MCUs (RISC V and/or Arm).
  • Build and optimize real-time signal-processing pipelines (fixed-point and/or floating-point), potentially including FFTs, filters, modulation/demodulation, codecs, feature extraction, or control loops.
  • Develop firmware using a mix of C/C++ (and selective assembly where appropriate), with strong focus on performance, memory, and power optimization.
  • Work with SoC/board peripherals: DMA, timers, SPI, I²C, UART, I²S/TDM, PWM, GPIO, and relevant bus fabrics.
  • Bring up new hardware: boot flows, clocks, memory maps, interrupt vectors, peripheral init, and early validation.
  • Implement and debug drivers and RTOS components (e.g., Zephyr or equivalent), including task scheduling, synchronization primitives, and ISR design.
  • Develop test strategies: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, test automation, and manufacturing/production diagnostics.
  • Use debugging/profiling tools: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, trace (ETM/ITM), and cycle-accurate profiling when available.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, FPGA/ASIC, systems, and application teams to define requirements and interfaces.
  • Contribute documentation: architecture notes, interface specs, timing budgets, work packages, and bring-up guides.
  • Participate in code reviews and help establish best practices for embedded quality, safety, and maintainability.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong professional experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for MCUs and/or DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with RISC V and/or Arm architecture (Cortex M/A), including interrupts, memory, caches, and performance characteristics.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software fundamentals:
  • register-level programming, memory-mapped I/O
  • concurrency (ISRs, RTOS tasks), race conditions, timing determinism
  • fixed-point arithmetic, numerical precision, and overflow/underflow management
  • Proven ability to optimize firmware: cycle counting, memory layout, DMA usage, cache behavior, minimizing latency and jitter.
  • Comfortable with toolchains and build systems:
  • GCC/LLVM-based toolchains, cross-compilation
  • CMake/Make, Meson, linker scripts, map files
  • Strong debugging skills with hardware and firmware:
  • JTAG/SWD debugging
  • root-cause analysis of timing and performance issues
  • Source control expertise (Git) and disciplined engineering practices (code reviews, CI).

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Languages: C, C++, (optional) assembly, Python for test tooling/scripts
  • Architectures: RISC V, Arm Cortex M/A, DSP cores
  • RTOS/OS: Zephyr, embedded Linux (optional)
  • Tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, GDB, OpenOCD/J-Link, logic analyzer, oscilloscope, trace tools
  • Practices: profiling, timing analysis, unit/integration testing, CI/CD for embedded
  • Experience with common DSP libraries/techniques (e.g., CMSIS-DSP, vendor DSP libs) and SIMD/vector optimization patterns.
  • Experience with Zephyr, or embedded Linux on Arm.
  • Familiarity with bootloaders, secure boot, OTA update mechanisms, and field diagnostics.
  • Understanding of digital communications, or audio, processing domains.
  • Exposure to safety/security standards (e.g., MISRA C/C++, IEC 61508, ISO 26262)

You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic. #LI-PD1 #LI-Hybrid

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Geef richting aan de toekomst van high-tech elektronica.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële systemen tot geavanceerde semicon-oplossingen: onze Electrical Engineers staan aan de basis van technologie die wereldwijd wordt toegepast. Ben jij de leider die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, kennis en technische excellence? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Als Electrical Engineering Manager beweeg jij je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt je je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar ook op de technische uitdagingen van morgen. Je stimuleert kennisontwikkeling, versterkt engineering excellence en helpt richting te geven aan de verdere groei van Electrical Engineering binnen Benchmark.

Je geeft leiding aan een team van circa 40 engineers en speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste technische disciplines binnen Benchmark. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, groei en prestaties van de organisatie en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers kunnen excelleren, innoveren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

Met jouw visie op leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en technologie bouw je aan een sterke engineeringcultuur waarin vakmanschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze Electrical Engineering-organisatie klaar blijft voor de complexe technologische vraagstukken van onze klanten én de ambities van de toekomst.

Jij combineert technisch leiderschap, people management en strategische ontwikkeling. Daarom ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van circa 40 Electrical Engineers.

  • Het leiden van de AI-transformatie binnen Electrical Engineering.

  • Het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie op Electrical Engineering en het vertalen hiervan naar de praktijk.

  • Het stimuleren van innovatie, kennisontwikkeling en technische excellentie binnen het vakgebied.

  • Het ontwikkelen van competenties, groeipaden en vakmanschap binnen jouw team.

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit, capaciteit en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Het ondersteunen en adviseren van Program Managers bij complexe ontwikkelprojecten.

  • Het aantrekken, selecteren en ontwikkelen van technisch talent.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking met internationale engineering teams binnen Benchmark.

  • Het bijdragen aan organisatie brede besluitvorming als onderdeel van het Competence Management Team en aan een lerende organisatie waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan.

Samen met de managers van Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de totale engineeringorganisatie. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines, waaronder HR. Omdat het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van talent in deze schaarse arbeidsmarkt essentieel is, beschik je over een sterk professioneel netwerk en weet je talent aan je team en organisatie te verbinden.

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Nienke Bloemendaal via

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

title: Expression of Interest - Internships
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Internship - Expression of Interest

We're always interested in hearing from exceptional students who want to work on the hardest problems in AI infrastructure - bringing novel accelerators to life, building the systems that orchestrate them, and charting the new territories of what heterogeneous compute can do.

There's no formal internship programme or fixed cycle here - internships happen when the need and the right person come together. This form is how we keep track of who to reach out to when that happens. If you think you have unique skills to contribute, or are studying or have experience in any of the following, we'd love to hear from you:

  • High-performance systems and low-level performance engineering

  • Inference infrastructure, orchestration, or distributed systems

  • Hardware bring-up, kernel development, or accelerator programming

  • Simulation, modelling, or workload design

This is a general interest form rather than an application for a specific internship. We review all submissions on an ongoing basis and will reach out when we see a strong match and the right opportunity comes up.

title: Finance Manager – Automatisierung & KI (all genders) | Voll- oder Teilzeit | ab sofort
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die MainTea GmbH. Ein wachsendes Food-Tech-Unternehmen aus Frankfurt.

Mit unseren Marken Besser im Glas, Bubble Pop, PRO2BE, Honest Coco und SMOOOTH IT bringen wir innovative Produkte in den Lebensmitteleinzelhandel und den E-Commerce und entwickeln gleichzeitig als operativer Mikro-VC neue Marken und Produktideen.

Mit unserem Wachstum werden auch unsere Finanzprozesse über mehrere Gesellschaften hinweg komplexer – und wir wollen sie nicht mit mehr Händen, sondern mit besseren Systemen lösen. Deshalb suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit im Bereich Finance, die Buchhaltung versteht und lebt und Lust hat, Finance Operations mit KI und Automatisierung neu zu denken. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Steuerbüro und den internen Teams zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Finance Operations: Verantwortung für die laufenden Finanzprozesse der Gruppe – von Kreditoren- und Debitorenmanagement über Zahlungsverkehr und Belegmanagement bis zur Vorbereitung für Monatsabschluss und Steuerbüro.

  • Prozessautomatisierung: Identifikation manueller, wiederkehrender Abläufe (z. B. Rechnungseingang, Zahlungsabgleich, Mahnwesen, Kontierung) und deren schrittweise Automatisierung mit Tools, Schnittstellen und KI-Agenten.

  • KI im Finance: Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung KI-gestützter Workflows – etwa für Auswertungen, Abstimmungen, Reportings oder die Prüfung von Zahlungsavisen. Du testest neue Tools und bringst das, was funktioniert, in den Alltag.

  • Systemlandschaft: Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Tools (u. a. DATEV, Moss, Xentral, Shopify) und Sicherstellung sauberer, durchgängiger Datenflüsse zwischen den Systemen.

  • Reporting & Transparenz: Aufbau und Automatisierung regelmäßiger Finanz-Reportings und KPIs für Geschäftsführung und Gesellschafter, damit wir jederzeit wissen, wo wir stehen.

  • Schnittstelle: Ansprechpartner:in für Steuerbüro und interne Teams in allen operativen Finanzthemen.

Qualifikation

  • Buchhaltungsverständnis: Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Accounting und erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) in Buchhaltung, Finance oder Controlling. Du weißt, was hinter einer Buchung steckt – musst aber kein Bilanzbuchhalter sein.

  • KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude schon heute selbstverständlich und hast Spaß daran, herauszufinden, was damit alles geht.

  • Tech- & Prozessdenken: Du denkst in Abläufen und Systemen. Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (z. B. Make, Zapier, n8n), fortgeschrittene Excel/Google-Sheets-Kenntnisse oder erste Schritte in SQL/Python sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Sorgfalt & Struktur: Genaue, zuverlässige und disziplinierte Arbeitsweise und Überblick auch über mehrere Gesellschaften hinweg.

  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Mindset: Ownership, Neugier, Hands-on. Du gibst dich nicht mit „haben wir immer so gemacht“ zufrieden.

Benefits

  • Team & Kultur: Offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Arbeitsumfeld mit regelmäßigen Teamevents und echter Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum, frühe Verantwortung und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – du baust den Finance-Bereich aktiv mit auf.

  • Moderne Tools: Zugang zu aktuellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.

  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage sowie ein strukturiertes und modernes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: Frisches Team Lunch an drei Tagen pro Woche durch unsere Köchin sowie eine wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Flexible Vorteile: Wahl zwischen Wellhub für Fitness & Gesundheit oder steuerfreien Sachbezügen.

Wenn du Lust hast, unseren Finance-Bereich mit KI und Automatisierung auf das nächste Level zu bringen, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

title: Financial Risk Principal Consultant (Senior Manager)
descriptionHtml:
Financial Risk Transformation Principal Consultant (Senior Manager)

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Lead complex risk transformation across financial services at scale

The Role

Capco is seeking a Financial Risk Transformation Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. In this role, you'll lead strategic client engagements, advise senior stakeholders including Chief Risk Officers, and drive transformation across risk functions. You'll play a key role in shaping large-scale programmes spanning liquidity, credit, market, and model risk, helping clients modernise their risk capabilities through data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled ways of working. You'll leverage approved AI tools to enhance insight, improve delivery efficiency, and support better decision-making while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex risk transformation programmes across liquidity, credit, market, and model risk, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation to improve client outcomes.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on regulatory frameworks including Basel, IFRS 9, and BCBS 239, translating regulatory requirements into practical transformation strategies and sustainable operating models.
  • Design and implement enhanced risk controls, target operating models, governance frameworks, and data-driven reporting solutions that strengthen regulatory compliance and business performance.
  • Drive the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve risk processes, reporting, forecasting, and decision-making while ensuring appropriate governance and validation.
  • Contribute to business development, proposition development, client relationship growth, and the continued expansion of Capco's Financial Risk capability.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience delivering financial risk transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting.
  • Deep expertise across liquidity risk, credit risk, market risk, and model risk, with strong knowledge of Basel, IFRS 9, BCBS 239, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes and influencing senior stakeholders, including Chief Risk Officers and executive leadership teams.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools and automation to enhance delivery while maintaining sound professional judgement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex risk challenges into practical, business-focused solutions.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience applying AI, automation, or advanced analytics within financial risk transformation or regulatory reporting environments.
  • Proven track record in proposition development, business development, and supporting go-to-market strategies.
  • Experience with enterprise data architecture, risk technology platforms, model implementation, or regulatory reporting solutions.
  • Leadership experience including mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing consulting teams.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance, Technology, Treasury, and Compliance.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured leadership development.
  • Help shape the future of financial risk transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.
  • Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across global financial services.

Benefits

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family Care: Eight complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: Five weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Minimum 40 Hours of Training Annually. Take your pick—workshops, certifications, and e-learning—your growth, your way. Business Coach assigned from Day One to help accelerate your development.
  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.
  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know—we'll be happy to help. We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration—a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: First Hire GTM - New Products (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
You turn new ideas into revenue at Reonic. Find the opportunity, test it, make it happen.

Looking for a role where you don't just support growth but actually own it? This is for you. You'll work directly with installers to uncover real problems, turn those insights into new products and services, and take them from first idea to go-to-market. Working closely with our Venture Development team, you'll have the freedom and responsibility to figure out what works - and the pace to make it happen.

Please note that for this role, C2 German proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

What You’ll Do

  • Go-to-market for new products and services inside our software. Which installers need this service? How do we reach them? What can we charge? What are the selling points? You don't find the answers at your desk, you find them by trying things.

  • Customer immersion and spotting new revenue streams. Daily conversations with installers to find out where their processes really hurt, pressure-test ideas against reality, and sell what you've built together with the Venture Development team.

  • Commercial responsibility. You figure out which model works: commission, fixed price, bundled pricing, or a partner share. And you see early whether a channel has enough potential to keep pushing.

  • Cross-functional execution. You pull sales, marketing, tech, and external partners together around your topic and keep it moving. You're the one who calls the next step and makes sure it happens.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Native or C2-level German and fluent English.

  • You've already brought something to market, or at least tried: your own project, a campaign, a product during an internship. What matters isn't the outcome, it's that you got going.

  • Strong sense of ownership and impatient if things don't move fast.

  • You'd rather talk to customers than build a theory at your desk.

  • You're comfortable with open situations and get your own answers.

  • Top university background with a clear entrepreneurial streak.

  • First experience in sales, growth, or product is a plus, but not a must.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of one of the fastest growing VC-backed startup in Germany with 3000+ satisfied B2B customers.

  • A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

  • Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • Embrace the freedom to innovate and make quick changes in a dynamic team.

  • Perks include gym membership ,or Deutschlandticket, Uber Eats after 7pm, Uber home after 7:30pm, regular team events, and a MacBook.

  • Receive competitive pay.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.


About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

title: Fixed-Wing Test Pilot H/F
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Fixed-Wing Test Pilot, you will operate Alta Ares' fixed-wing drones during development and demos. You will act as the Safety Pilot during experimental flights, ensuring mission success and platform integrity. Over time, you will also contribute to training, documentation, and continuous improvement of operational procedures.

Flight Operations

  • Operate fixed-wing UAVs during development tests and demos

  • Execute manual piloting tasks, including executing non-standard or complex takeoff and landing procedures.

  • Serve as Safety Pilot during avionics hardware and software testing, closely monitoring aircraft behavior and taking manual control when required.

  • Work with the flight-controller team to provide detailed feedback on anomalies or unexpected behavior.

  • Validate aircraft airworthiness and pre-flight checks.

Aircraft Maintenance

  • Prepare, organize, and maintain flight-test and demo equipment.

  • Routine maintenance of the UAV

  • Repairs and hardware adjustments

Requirements

  • Proven experience flying fixed-wing UAVs (required).

  • Strong understanding of aerodynamics, CG balancing, and basic aircraft mechanics.

  • Ability to troubleshoot propulsion systems, particularly turbines.

  • Familiarity with flight-control systems, tuning, and parameter testing.

  • Hands-on skills in maintenance and repair of UAV platforms.

  • Strong safety mindset and ability to operate under test-flight conditions.
