title: Fleet Shift Manager
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

  

Role Overview 📝

he Fleet Shift Manager oversees the work of the Fleet Coordinators. This team owns the day-to-day control, inspection, and performance of the vehicle fleet, ensuring vehicles are safe, available, compliant, and cost-controlled.

This team is responsible for early detection of damage and risk, fast recovery of repair costs, and close coordination with Maintenance and Operations to protect vehicle uptime and service reliability.

This team is also responsible for Fleet coordinating Delivery Driver daily vehicle collection & return.

This role involve team management as well as execution support.

Location will be primarily at one of our vehicle storage locations, but will involve some travel to and time at the nearby Depot. You may be asked to - very occasionally - support at our other Depot.

You will be working 5 in 7 days; this could be either Sun-Thurs or Tues-Sat.

You will report to one of our Fleet Senior Managers.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

Team management:

  • Ensure high process adherence and standards on-site, across Front-end and Back-end teams

  • Manage team of Coordinators & Night Chargers

  • Ensure coverage in case of sickness / absence

  • Escalate & fix issues

Execution support:

  • Daily on-site execution support

  • 2 mornings / week - vehicle inspections at different site

  • Cover for team-members’ sickness / holidays as needed

Vehicle-related responsibilities:

  • Ensure all vehicles are inspected, logged, and controlled to agreed standards.

  • Carry out basic repairs where possible and collaborate with local garage for more complex repairs

  • Coordinate repairs and servicing with Fleet Maintenance to minimise downtime.

  • Coordinate On the Road Breakdown with Fleet Maintenance/Third Party Partners to minimise downtime.

  • Protect fleet uptime through early issue identification and prioritisation.

  • Monitor driver behaviour and escalate safety or performance risks.

  • Ensure key management processes followed & regularly audit keys.

  • Ensure full compliance with health & safety and fleet standards.

  • Produce clear fleet performance insights and improvement actions.

Driver-related responsibilities:

  • Morning shift:

    • Allocate & hand over vehicles to Delivery Drivers, & coordinate route allocation.

  • Evening shift:

    • Receive vehicle returns, ensure vehicles correctly returned with keys.

    • Receive undelivered parcels & return to Depot.

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 2-5 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles.

  • Experience of working with vehicles - uptime, light repairs, vehicle inspections, maintenance & servicing.

  • Experience managing teams successfully - achieving results, maintaining high standards.

  • Valid Driving licence (held for minimum of 12 mths, maximum 6 points)

  • High integrity & trustworthiness.

  • High urgency, proactivity, and ownership.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Able to communicate effectively & build relationships & work cross-functionally

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

    • if you're on a 4 days on - 4 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 18 days paid holiday plus public holidays

    • similarly on 4 days on - 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Annual compensation review

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Dog friendly office and depots

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)


🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

  • HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

  • Read how HIVED raised $42M to transform parcel delivery with AI and all-electric logistics network

  • Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

  • Keep up with HIVED ✨here✨

title: Forward-Deployed Banker
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. The Customer Success Manager will join a team of trusted partners alongside their Account Manager, working closely with newly onboarded and existing clients to demonstrate the full value of our platform, develop strong client engagement, drive successful renewals and contribute to growth across dedicated accounts. They are natural problem-solvers, storytellers and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.

Customer Success Managers combine deep product knowledge, industry experience and ability to build strong client relationships to ensure that each client interaction is both meaningful and impactful. Due to their extensive exposure to a variety of clients both on the buy-side and sell-side, they are the Voice of the Customer, working closely alongside our Product Management and Content teams to help determine future product developments, as well as playing a key role in product Betas and the customer feedback loop.

About the Role: 

As a Forward-Deployed Banker, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and delivering ongoing value to our clients, working closely with the wider account team to positively impact net retention. You’ll engage directly with clients and develop a comprehensive understanding of their workflows, challenges, and goals; bridging the gap between the powerful capabilities of our technology and the domain-specific needs of financial professionals across: Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity/Venture Capital and Hedge Funds.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Partner with GTM Teams to Drive Commercial Outcomes: Collaborate closely with your Account Manager and the wider account management team to ensure continuous alignment of account strategies and goals. 
  • Leverage Data Driven Insights: Use internal data tools to monitor client engagement, identify opportunities to showcase value, and strengthen platform adoption. Proactively seek growth opportunities while also detecting early signs of churn risk to support retention and long-term account success.
  • Build and Curate Financial Services Use Cases: Conduct targeted discovery into clients' unique research workflows and painpoints in order to help them effectively leverage AlphaSense for their bespoke use cases. Continue to seek out and develop new and emerging use cases with clients as AlphaSense’s capabilities evolve.
  • Forge and Maintain Strong Client Relationships: Engage directly with investment professionals of all levels/seniority at financial institutions to understand their most pressing challenges and goals. Deliver white glove service that puts the clients needs first; going above and beyond to build trust and credibility as a Trusted Partner and Product Expert.
  • Contribute to Product Development: Translate client feedback and proactively share product & content improvements/enhancement requests internally.

Who You Are:

You have a proven track record of working with Financial Services investors/clients to solve complex problems and are passionate about the application of AI to the industry. You are client-centric and creative thinker with an ambition to continuously improve processes and a desire to contribute to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial team culture. You are a natural problem solver and prioritise white glove service to go above and beyond for clients. You enjoy autonomy and proactively drive initiatives that contribute to long term success. You enjoy cross-functional partnerships and are able to build strong internal stakeholder relationships.

What You Bring:

  • Financial Services Expertise: 2+ years of front-office investment banking experience, ideally with exposure to more than one product area (e.g., DCM, ECM, M&A, Leveraged Finance), providing a strong foundation in capital markets processes and client-facing deal work.
  • Curiosity About Generative AI in Financial Services: A demonstrated interest in the transformative potential of AI for the financial sector, flexible problem-solving skills and knowledge of the competitive landscape for GenAI in Financial Services.
  • Executive Presence & Strong Presentation Skills: A proven capacity to engage stakeholders at all levels, earn their trust, and explain technical solutions to business-oriented audiences. Comfort with conducting evaluations of varying lengths/forms e.g. on-site workshops, whiteboard sessions, multi-call demos etc.
  • High-Impact, Ownership Mindset: An exceptional ability to thrive on autonomy, tackle client questions and challenges with enthusiasm, and drive workflow transformation at some of the world's biggest financial firms.
  • Consultative Approach: A highly articulate, consultative, and confident client-facing professional with the ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • Team Player: Superior ability to build and maintain strong internal relationships, combined with a positive and proactive personality.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively distill client feedback to GTM, Product, and Content teams, in order to continually help influence and improve our capabilities/product offerings.
  • A Proactive Mindset with a passion for client success and continuous improvement

Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of front-office investment banking experience across at least one product area, with a solid grounding in capital markets and client-facing deal execution.
  • High aptitude and willingness to learn.
  • Outstanding oral, written, and presentation skills.
  • Effective attention to detail, time management, and task prioritization, even when under pressure.
  • Ability and interest to work autonomously and contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.
  • Empathetic, curious minded, client-centric

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

Future founders: learn how to transform an industry using AI. You work directly with our founders on the topics that matter most right now, from investor updates and product to growth and finance, and you own each workstream from question to result.

Tasks

  • Investor relations. Prepare investor updates and board materials, from KPIs and financials to the storyline.

  • Reporting, controlling and finance. Build and maintain the reporting and financial planning that keeps Taxforce running, and support our invoicing, cashflow management and the monthly internal close.

  • Product. Shape our business intelligence product for practices, from monthly business analyses (BWA) to the reports that show practice owners where they stand on revenue, costs and liquidity.

  • Growth. Build and test ways to win new practices, from lead lists and outreach to content, partnerships and pricing.

  • Onboarding and support. Maintain our client onboarding process and help run client support, so that happy practices drive organic growth.

  • Getting things done. Own topics that cut across teams or have no owner yet, fix manual workflows at the root and automate them with AI as you go.

What this role is not: an assistant role, or strategy that stays on slides.

Requirements

  • Drive & ambition. You go the extra mile and thrive in fast-paced startup environments.

  • First practical experience. You’ve done internships or working student roles, ideally in consulting, investment banking, VC or tech.

  • Strong academic background. You study at or graduated from a well-regarded university or business school.

  • Analytical mindset. You break down complex problems and prioritise between many tasks.

  • Tech-savvy. You use AI tools every day and build small automations yourself.

  • German language skills. Our clients mostly speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and strong English (C1+).

Benefits

  • Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder.

  • Learn from founders who have done it before. Work alongside a former Y Combinator founder and see first-hand how a company is built from zero.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it.

  • Hands-on venture building. Broad scope across growth, finance, operations and technology instead of one narrow function.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

  • Future founders. Build the skills and the network to start your own company in a few years.

  • A path to stay. Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

title: Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut.

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren. Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3)

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

  • Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

  • Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

  • Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

  • AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3)

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

  • Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

  • Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

  • Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

  • Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate, Vollzeit

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

Wie du arbeitest

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht.

  • AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup.

  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier)

  • Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung: Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Was du danach kannst

  1. Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt.

  2. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient.

  3. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden.

  4. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr.

Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen

Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran: Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst.

Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen

  1. Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln.

  2. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago.

Wie du dabei wächst

  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm.

  • Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch.

  • Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

  • Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung.

  • Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup

  • First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/

Zusätzlich bieten wir:

  • Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community.

  • Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung.

Closing

1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung

Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast.

2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Maria, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen.

3. Gespräch mit den Gründern (25 Minuten)

Lerne Janick oder Ann-Christin kennen, mit denen du jeden Tag zusammenarbeiten wirst. Vorab bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe, die du im Gespräch kurz vorstellst. Perfekt muss sie nicht sein. Uns interessiert vor allem, wie du an Dinge herangehst.

4. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort)

Besuche uns in München und arbeite mit uns an einer realistischen Aufgabe – z. B. einen Hiring-Funnel strukturieren, ein Produkt-Setup vorbereiten oder eine interne Automatisierung entwerfen. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst.

5. Entscheidung

Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

💡 Bewirb dich direkt hier über „Jetzt bewerben“ mit deinem Lebenslauf und deiner Story.

title: Founding Product Manager (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.

We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.

You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how manufacturing and systems-engineering teams work

  • Identify and define the highest-value customer problems for BoWatt to solve

  • Help own and prioritise the product roadmap

  • Balance strategic opportunities, recurring customer needs, commercial importance, and engineering effort

  • Drive product initiatives from initial discovery through scoping, development, launch, and iteration

  • Give engineers the context and clarity needed to make strong implementation decisions

  • Prototype and test potential solutions with customers before and during development

  • Work with Customer Success to turn individual customer feedback into scalable product improvements

  • Use qualitative feedback and product data to understand adoption and evaluate whether features are working

  • Triage product issues and bugs, make clear prioritisation decisions, and coordinate with Engineering

  • Improve BoWatt’s processes for discovery, prioritisation, product delivery, launches, and feedback

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

During your first six months, you will work closely with our engineering team to build the domain and product knowledge required to take ownership of increasingly important product areas.

You

  • You are deeply curious about customers and want to understand how their work actually happens

  • You enjoy turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear product decisions

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You can distinguish between an individual customer request and a scalable product opportunity

  • You make thoughtful trade-offs and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing technical constraints

  • You move quickly without losing sight of product quality or customer outcomes

  • You take ownership of results rather than simply managing tickets and meetings

  • You want to build a product function rather than inherit an established playbook

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and excited to become an expert in a complex industry

Requirements

  • At least two years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, or a comparable product-building role

  • Experience shipping B2B software in close collaboration with engineers

  • Experience conducting product discovery and translating customer problems into clear requirements

  • Strong prioritisation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills

  • The ability to understand technical products and communicate with engineers, technical users, and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Four days per week in our Munich office at Balanstraße

  • Experience with enterprise software, AI products, manufacturing, engineering, systems engineering, or early-stage startups is a bonus

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • Significant ownership over an important part of BoWatt’s product

  • The opportunity to help build BoWatt’s product function and ways of working

  • 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, making difficult trade-offs, and being responsible for the results.

 

As our Founding Product Manager, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and take meaningful ownership of how BoWatt’s product develops. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute screening call

  2. 90-minute live product case (CEO and team member)

  3. 60-minute culture interview (CEO)

We aim to complete the entire interview process within 14 days.

title: FTTH Security Expert
descriptionHtml:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security!

Language requirements

  • English - fluent speaker

  • French - optional

Further details

  • 🏢 Headquarters: Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE

  • 🏠 Remote policy:

  • At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Specialisations

Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

descriptionHtml:

Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen.

Les entreprises de l'écosystème Everfield évoluent selon un modèle décentralisé : elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu'elles font de mieux, développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Rôle

En tant que Gestionnaire Paie & RH, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille ( sous la convention Syntec). En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering Europe, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous travaillez avec un prestataire de paie externe.

Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques.

Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive)

  • Paie : préparer, contrôler et valider la paie mensuelle de plusieurs entités avec le prestataire externe ; gérer la DSN, les arrêts maladie, maternité et invalidité, la subrogation, la relation avec la CPAM, la mutuelle et la prévoyance ; mettre à jour les taux de cotisation et appliquer les minima et règles Syntec.

  • Administration RH : contrats et avenants, absences, avantages sociaux, dossiers du personnel prêts pour un audit.

  • Gestion des intégrations et des sorties : piloter le cycle d'entrée et de sortie des collaborateurs de bout en bout.

    • Intégrations : DPAE, contrat de travail, affiliation mutuelle et prévoyance, visite d'information et de prévention, création dans le SIRH et la paie, coordination de l'accueil avec les managers et suivi de la période d'essai.

    • Sorties : démissions, ruptures conventionnelles (homologation), licenciements, fins de période d'essai ; calcul du préavis et des indemnités selon Syntec, solde de tout compte, certificat de travail, attestation France Travail, portabilité mutuelle et prévoyance, restitution du matériel et clôture des accès.

  • Premier point de contact RH pour les collaborateurs, en français et en anglais.

  • Données et reporting : fiabilité des données dans le SIRH (Workday) et rapports pour les équipes RH et Finance, en anglais.

  • Appui aux HRBP : documentation disciplinaire, entretiens de sortie, déploiement de programmes RH.

Ce que nous recherchons (indispensable)

  • 3 ans minimum en gestion de paie française, dont au moins 2 ans sous la convention Syntec.

  • Maîtrise de la DSN et des absences complexes (maladie, maternité, invalidité, prévoyance).

title: Go-To-Market Engineer

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why HRtechX

We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. Who are we?

 

Options is the largest global financial technology company headquartered in Belfast. We are at the forefront of banking and trading infrastructure, serving clients globally with offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, London, Cambridge, Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, and Auckland. At Options, our services are woven into the hottest trends in global tech, including high-performance Networking, Cloud, Security, and AI (Artificial Intelligence).

Du bekommst Probleme, keine Tickets. Wenn etwas an dich übergeben wird, dann in der Form „hier klemmt es" und nicht „bau bitte genau das" – den Weg dahin entwirfst du. Und du bringst eigene Ideen mit: Was dir auffällt und was du für richtig hältst, landet auf derselben Liste wie alles andere.

Was du machst

  • Website und Landingpages: entwickeln, bauen, live stellen – inklusive der interaktiven Elemente, die eine Seite von einer Broschüre unterscheiden

  • Tracking, SEO und Hosting: dass die Seite schnell ist, gefunden wird und dass man den Zahlen dahinter trauen kann

  • Prototypen und Automationen: Die schnellste Version, die eine Frage beantwortet – ein Prototyp ist bei uns meistens auch ein Experiment, und du liest das Ergebnis mit

  • Tooling für Growth und Sales: z.B. Clay, Lemlist und was sonst gerade das Richtige ist. Leitfrage: Welche Handarbeit in diesem Team müsste es eigentlich nicht mehr geben?

  • Die Brücke zum Produkt: Du sitzt in Growth, gehst aber auch in die Dailys der Entwickler – vieles, was Marketing braucht, hängt am Produkt und umgekehrt

Wie es hier wirklich aussieht

Vieles ist unfertig. Unserem Tracking kann man an Stellen nicht trauen, und ein Teil der ersten Monate ist Aufräumen, bevor es Bauen wird. Dafür gilt das Gegenteil von dem, was du vielleicht kennst: kein Freigabeprozess, kein Ticketstapel, kein Warten auf eine andere Abteilung. Was du für richtig hältst, kannst du heute live stellen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast schon etwas selbst live gestellt – nicht nur lokal gebaut. Du weißt, wie ein Server von innen aussieht, was Hosting bedeutet und worin der Unterschied zwischen Herumprobieren und Ausliefern liegt.

  • Du willst nicht nur Entwickler:in sein. Marketing interessiert dich wirklich: Du verfolgst, was im Markt passiert, hast eine Meinung zu Kampagnen, die dir begegnen, und willst verstehen, warum Leute kaufen – nicht nur, wie man es technisch umsetzt.

  • Neugier auf Werkzeuge. Du probierst Neues aus, bevor dich jemand darum bittet, und hast Spaß daran, anderen im Team die Arbeit leichter zu machen.

  • Auge für Gestaltung. Du erkennst, ob eine Seite absichtsvoll aussieht, und kannst sagen, warum eine schwache Version schwach ist.

  • KI ist dein Normalzustand, nicht dein Nebenprojekt. Ohne würde dir das Arbeiten langsam vorkommen.

  • Eigene Ideen. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist – aber du kannst auch mit einer fremden Priorität arbeiten, ohne dass es dich stört.

hilfreich, aber nicht nötig

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot, GA4, GTM oder vergleichbaren Stacks

  • Eigene Projekte, ein Nebenprodukt, ein Shop, eine Seite, die Leute wirklich benutzen

  • SEO über die Grundlagen hinaus

kein Fit

  • Du willst reine Entwicklungsarbeit und Marketing ist dir egal

  • Du brauchst fertige Tickets, Reviews und einen Prozess, bevor du anfängst

  • Du hast noch nie etwas außerhalb deines eigenen Rechners live gestellt

  • Du arbeitest lieber monatelang an einer sauberen Lösung, als nächste Woche eine zu haben, die funktioniert

Das Level, auf dem wir einstellen

Das ist eine Einstiegs- bis Mid-Level-Rolle, und wir meinen das ernst: Uns zählt, was du schon gebaut und live gestellt hast, nicht wie viele Jahre dahinterstehen. Du berichtest an den Head of Growth.

Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher sowie Englisch auf C1-Niveau oder höher setzen wir voraus – unser Markt ist deutsch, unsere Teamsprache englisch.

Gehalt
65.000 bis 100.000 € je nach Erfahrung, dazu Stock Options.

Drei Runden: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Arbeitssession mit einer kleinen Aufgabe und eine letzte Runde mit den Gründer:innen. Ein Termin findet in Berlin persönlich statt, und du hörst in jeder Stufe innerhalb einer Woche von uns, auch wenn die Antwort nein ist.

Warum mika

  • Du stellst selbst live. Kein Freigabeprozess, keine fremde Abteilung dazwischen – was du für richtig hältst, ist heute online.

  • Viel ungetestete Fläche. Fast alles, was man anfassen kann, ist noch nie angefasst worden, und es gibt ein Budget dahinter.

  • Zwei Welten statt einer. Du sitzt in Growth und arbeitest mit den Entwicklern – wer beides lernen will, findet hier wenige vergleichbare Stellen.

  • Alle KI-Lizenzen sind da, und ihre Nutzung ist Erwartung, nicht Duldung.

  • Die Arbeit zählt auch außerhalb des Büros. Jedes Stück Automatisierung heißt, dass kleine Unternehmen weniger Zeit und Geld für Papierkram ausgeben, den sie sich nie ausgesucht haben.

  • Berlin, hybrid, vollkommen flexible Arbeitszeiten bis auf das tägliche Standup.

Klingt nach dir?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei Dinge, mehr nicht:

  1. Etwas, das du gebaut und live gestellt hast – ein Link reicht. Sag kurz dazu, was daran von dir ist und womit du es gebaut hast.

  2. Eine Sache, die du an unserer Website ändern würdest, nachdem du zwanzig Minuten daraufgeschaut hast.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Growth Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs - vom Suchen über das Kaufen bis zum Finanzieren. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und verwandeln sie in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen hands-on, datengetriebenen Growth Engineer, der als erste Person die technische Basis für unser Brokerage-Geschäft baut. Du verbindest unsere Verwaltungsdaten aus über 70.000 Einheiten mit CRM, Outreach-Tools und KI und baust daraus ein System, das automatisch erkennt, welche Eigentümer verkaufen wollen. Dadurch kommen wir gezielt mit verkaufswilligen Eigentümern ins Gespräch und können qualifizierte Leads an unsere Makler übermitteln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Inside-Sales-Team sowie dem Leadership-Team zusammen und baust Brokerage zu einem eigenen, profitablen Geschäftsfeld aus. Brokerage ist bei Buena noch ein kleines Geschäftsfeld, mit dir soll daraus ein Multi-Millionen-Geschäft werden.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Signal-Engine bauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

  • Outreach automatisieren: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

  • Funnel messbar machen: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat und trackst Kosten pro Lead sowie Conversion.

  • Experimente fahren: Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst und misst es sauber.

Du passt, wenn du

  • Hands-on Erfahrung als GTM Engineer, in Growth oder RevOps mitbringst und Systeme selbst gebaut hast.

  • Schon einmal etwas von null aufgebaut hast, etwa als Gründer, Geschäftsführer oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) beherrschst. Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Deine Benefits

  • Top-Vergütung inklusive VSOPs.

  • Bis zu 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros im Prenzlauer Berg.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat.

  • 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du baust unsere Akquise-Engine von null auf. Was du in den ersten Monaten aufsetzt, wird zur Grundlage des ganzen Geschäftsfelds. Wenn es funktioniert, skalierst du es selbst weiter und deine Rolle wächst mit.

  • Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt aufs Geschäft. Du hast Zugriff auf Daten aus unserem Verwaltungsbestand, die sonst niemand hat und arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen: Jedes Signal, das funktioniert, wird zu messbarem Umsatz im Brokerage.

  • Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitenden im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

title: Head of Clinical Operations
descriptionHtml:
🏨 About the company

Resilience Care is a leading provider of remote patient monitoring and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is to improve care.

We provide remote patient monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePROs) with AI techniques. Our solutions include a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals, enabling the early detection of side effects and continuous, proactive care, as well as a mobile app that helps patients track and manage their symptoms through tailored resources.

Our solutions help optimise care, deepen our understanding of patients throughout their care journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. They are currently used in routine care by 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as in around 20 academic and industry-sponsored clinical studies.

We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition of helping every patient benefit from personalised medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell

You will lead all of Resilience’s clinical operations: Resilience-sponsored randomised controlled trials (RCTs), investigator-initiated studies (ISRs), real-world evidence (RWE) projects and studies conducted for industry partners. You will report directly to the Chief Medical Officer, manage a team of five to six people, including CTMs and Senior CTMs, and step in operationally on projects when backup is needed.

Your impact

You will ensure that every study is delivered on time, within budget and to the expected quality standards, while keeping the team’s workload manageable. You will give the medical leadership team a reliable overview of the study portfolio—including timelines, budgets and the risk register—and prepare clinical operations to support a growing number of industry partners.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Lead the study portfolio: manage budgets, timelines, risk registers, GCP compliance, milestones and performance indicators; run the weekly review of all projects and their reporting.

  • Allocate projects and manage the team’s workload: assign tasks, organise backup, prioritise and anticipate recruitment needs.

  • Manage and develop the team—Senior CTMs, CTMs and Clinical Research Associates (CRAs)—through goal-setting, reviews and coaching. Give the team the structure and autonomy it needs to succeed.

  • Ensure quality and compliance: maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates and tools; prepare for audits and inspections; and ensure compliance with GCP, ICH guidelines, the French Jardé law and GDPR.

  • Act as the escalation point for sites, investigators and partners on delays, budget overruns and quality issues.

  • Build the operational model for our clinical research offering for industry partners, including study costing, processes, tools and staffing, in collaboration with the Commercial, Legal and Finance teams.

  • Work cross-functionally across Resilience, including with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Data Management, Finance, Regulatory, Compliance, Market Access and Product.

✨ Your team

  • Your team: five to six people—Senior Clinical Trial Managers, Clinical Trial Managers and CRAs—who each manage their projects end to end across several therapeutic areas.

  • Your future colleagues: the Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Data Management and Product teams, as well as Legal and Finance.

  • Your manager: Charles Ferté, Chief Medical Officer and hiring manager for the role.

  • What makes the team special: we move forward together, look for practical solutions and take time to celebrate our successes.

👤 What we’re looking for

⚙️ You’ll be a great fit if you can:

  • Manage several studies in parallel, including their budgets, timelines, resources and risks.

  • Lead a clinical operations team, balance workloads and develop each team member’s autonomy.

  • Estimate study costs, build budgets and monitor spending.

  • Build and maintain a quality system—including SOPs, templates and audit preparation—that complies with GCP, ICH guidelines, the French Jardé law and GDPR.

  • Manage relationships with sites, investigators and industry partners, including in escalation situations.

  • Work in English at a professional level, both written and spoken.

🙂 You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • Strong clinical research expertise, particularly in GCP, study budgets and timelines.

  • Strong leadership: you provide a clear framework, trust your team and make decisions.

  • Strategic vision and the ability to exercise sound judgement, even in ambiguous situations.

  • Clear, structured communication that you can adapt to both leadership and operational teams.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative, cross-functional mindset.

📃 You’ll be a great fit if you have:

  • A degree in life sciences, pharmacy, clinical research or biomedical engineering—MSc, MD, PharmD or PhD.

  • At least eight years of experience in clinical research, including three years managing a team or a study portfolio.

  • Led studies for sponsors or industry partners in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotech or medtech environment.

  • Ideally, experience with real-world studies or medical devices. Knowledge of ISO 14155 is a plus.

💛 Why join us?

  • Lead clinical operations at a growing medtech company.

title: Head of Hardware
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The Role

As Head of Hardware, you own the physical realization of our humanoid platform. You take the robot from a working prototype to a machine that can be built repeatably, reliably, and at rising volume. You come from mechanical engineering and have shipped mechanically demanding products in serious quantities. You are not an electronics designer, but you have led enough electronics work to hold that discipline to the same standard: to read a power budget, question a thermal margin, and know when a schematic review is being rushed.

You work directly with the founders and with the Head of System, who owns the robot's architecture and behavior. You own how that architecture becomes a physical product. The Mechanical Lead, Electronics Lead, and Integration & Operations Lead report to you.


Key responsibilities

  • Physical product ownership. Own structures, actuation packaging, electronics integration, harnessing, and thermal behavior of the robot as a built object.

  • Industrialization. Drive the path from one-off builds to repeatable low-volume production and beyond: DFM, tolerance strategy, supplier and tooling decisions, build documentation, and yield.

  • Engineering leadership. Build, mentor, and lead the mechanical, electronics, and integration teams. Set the hiring bar and grow leads into the roles the company will need in two years.

  • Standards and process. Establish design review practice, release and change control, requirements traceability into physical design, and the technical decision frameworks that keep a growing team coherent.

  • Reliability and validation. Own robustness and lifetime of the hardware. Define what has to be tested, drive the test infrastructure, and make validation results the basis of design decisions rather than an afterthought.

  • Safety in the physical domain. Champion safety-first engineering for machines that share space with people, building on our functional safety work in ISO TC299 and the emerging humanoid standards.

  • Supply chain and cost. Own hardware cost structure, supplier selection, and the make-versus-buy decisions that determine how fast we can scale.

  • Interface with system architecture. Partner with the Head of System so that architectural decisions are made with manufacturability, cost, and serviceability on the table from the start.

Your profile

Who We Are Looking For

  • Depth in mechanical engineering. 10+ years with a mechanical or mechatronics core, including hands-on years before the leadership years. You have designed real parts and lived with the consequences.

  • Shipped at scale. You have taken a mechanically demanding product from prototype to series production in automotive, industrial machinery, or a comparable consumer hardware category. You know what breaks between a working prototype and a thousand units, because you have been there.

  • Electrical breadth. You have led or worked closely with electronics teams. You can evaluate an EE architecture, challenge assumptions on power, EMC, and thermal, and recruit and assess electronics engineers with confidence. Deep circuit design is not expected.

  • Leadership of leads. You have built organizations of 20 or more engineers across disciplines and have managed managers, not only individual contributors.

  • Supplier and manufacturing fluency. Real experience with tooling, qualification, and industrialization partners, including the negotiation and escalation that comes with them.

  • Mindset. Pragmatic and hands-on. Comfortable in a company where the product is not finished and the answer is often unknown. You would rather see the robot on the bench than the slide about the robot.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, legged systems, or high-dynamic mechatronics.

  • Exposure to functional safety in machinery or automotive, for example ISO 13849, IEC 61508, or ISO 26262.

  • Background in a company that scaled its hardware organization through a growth phase.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Head of Risk
descriptionHtml:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

  

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

  

Background and Experience

Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts).

Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes.

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

  • The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role.

Our recruitment philosophy


We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary and global benefit package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to semi-flexible working hours=

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process.

As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

title: Head of Strategy & Insights
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Overview

WPP Media is seeking a Head of Strategy & Insights to lead the global media strategies for one of the most prestigious global luxury groups in the world. Sitting at the intersection of culture, audience, planning, and insights, you will oversee a talented team to deliver transformative media strategies across a prestigious portfolio of Maisons.

For this critical leadership role, we are seeking an "M-shaped" talent. You bring a broad knowledge of communications, media, and luxury, combining big-picture strategic thinking with the technical fluency to dive into expert topics. You are equally comfortable advising on high-level strategy as you are coordinating specialized teams to turn macro-visions into high-quality execution.

As a trusted advisor to Maisons C-suite stakeholders, you will go beyond traditional media planning to shape long-term brand equity, champion luxury intelligence, and elevate planning excellence across our global network of over 40 markets.

* Location: Paris

* Team management: 5-6 people (Senior to Manager Media Planning & Insights Talents)

* Client: Global Luxury group

* Language: French & English

Key Responsibilities

  1. Strategy & Planning Excellence
  • Team Leadership: Direct and inspire a global team of five strategic planners (ranging from Manager to Senior profiles), ensuring the high-quality delivery of strategic media recommendations across diverse briefs and a varied Maisons portfolio.
  • Annual Media Strategy: Define the overarching annual media strategy for the group leading Maisons, across various luxury categories.
  • Media Guidelines: Define and oversee the creation of media planning guidelines (annual or high-stakes campaigns). Establish their structure and coordinate relevant internal teams (e.g., Social and Search experts) to ensure their successful completion.
  • Planning Framework: Elevate local market planning quality by refining existing planning frameworks and enforcing their adoption, supported directly by the Planning & Insights Capabilities Associate Director.
  1. Luxury Thought Leadership & Intelligence
  • Intelligence Agenda: Define the annual Luxury Thought Leadership calendar; oversee the creation and presentation of high-impact intelligence reports and global webinars.
  • Macro-Consultancy: Partner with Maisons and relevant WPP agencies on forward-looking, long-term prospective topics that extend well beyond pure paid media.
  • Knowledge Ecosystem: Foster a culture of luxury intelligence-sharing, ensuring a seamless flow of insights between central and local market teams.
  1. Tools & Insights
  • Planning & Insights Capability: Manage and mentor the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director to enforce the consistent application of WPP Media "hero" planning and insight tools across the entire account network, ensuring data-driven strategic foundations.
  • Global Research Agenda: In collaboration with the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director, define the global studies agenda, overseeing research execution and the delivery of actionable insights to the client.

  1. Local Market Support & Connectivity
  • Global Upskilling: Refine and deploy planning and insights training programs tailored for local market teams and planning resources.
  • Network Synergy: Build influential relationships with top-tier global markets to capture local best practices, maximize global strategy adoption, and elevate localized execution.

Requirements & Profile

  • Global Strategic Planning Experience: 10–15+ years of experience within integrated communications and media planning, with a heavy emphasis on global or multi-market accounts.
  • Luxury Expertise: Deep, demonstrable expertise within the luxury sector (Fashion, Jewelry, and Watches preferred), with a thorough understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and differences across Maisons and regions.
  • Holistic Comms Thinking: Proven ability to think beyond traditional paid media, demonstrating an integrated communications planning mindset that connects media strategy with broader cultural and brand ecosystems.
  • C-Suite Gravitas: Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to engage, persuade, and challenge C-suite executives through strong, well-reasoned convictions.
  • Team Management: A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and inspiring diverse strategic teams; a natural collaborator and team player.
  • Strategic Agility: A highly flexible thinker capable of adapting strategic frameworks across a wide variety of brands with vastly different budgets, target audiences, and ambitions.
  • Cross-Department Orchestration: Proven ability to collaborate with and coordinate across diverse, specialized expert teams (e.g., Social, Search, and Centralized Buying) to align channel tactics with overarching macro-strategy.
  • Language: Full professional fluency in both English and French
  • Curiosity: A genuine appetite for working in a highly international, multicultural environment.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.
