title: Ingénieur.e de recherche (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :

• Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
• Autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe.

title: Intern/Working Student, Alpha Engineering Design Team
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE
At Proxima Fusion, we’re driven by a bold mission – to redefine the future of sustainable energy. Our unique concept, built upon the groundbreaking W7-X stellarator and the latest advances in technology, paves the way for commercially viable fusion power plants. What’s more, our work in stellarator optimization, powered by cutting-edge computation and machine learning is propelling us into uncharted territories of fusion technology. New higher performance design points are unlocked by high temperature superconducting magnets. To fully grasp this opportunity, we’re building a team of dedicated and passionate people who come together driving something extraordinary, radically transforming technology in the world.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION
You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You’ll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT
Join Proxima's Alpha Engineering Design team and help build Alpha, our flagship machine and the world's first high-temperature superconducting stellarator. Alpha is designed to de-risk the technologies needed for Stellaris, our future fusion power plant.
You'll take on a well-defined engineering project with real impact on Alpha's design. You'll work closely with experienced engineers and a technical mentor, and learn how a fusion machine goes from concept to hardware. Your role would be in the Magnet Support Structures team, responsible for structural and thermomechanical analysis of the systems that hold the superconducting coils in place under extreme electromagnetic and cryogenic loads.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Contribute to the design, analysis or testing of Alpha systems, working with the physics, mechanical and structural teams.
Carry out engineering studies such as finite element simulations, design trade-offs, prototyping, experiments or simulation development, depending on your area.
Document your results and present them to the team, and turn your findings into concrete design recommendations.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Robotics/Mechatronics, or a related field. You must stay enrolled for the whole internship or working student contract.

  • High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes.
    Curious, proactive and a strong problem-solver. You like hard challenges and aren't afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.

  • Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential).

  • Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum.

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential.

LOGISTICS
Office: Munich, on-site.
Timings: 3 - 12 months full-time (part-time is possible) as an intern.

Start: Flexible between January - March 2027

INTERVIEW PROCESS
Behavioural and Technical Screening (30 min)
Technical Panel (1x60 min)

This role sits at L1 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information*

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: International Expansion
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Ideally, you would be able to start by February 2027.

Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Investor in Residence
descriptionHtml:
About the role

You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do.

We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. title: Junior AI consultant
descriptionHtml:
Locatie: Utrecht | Dienstverband: Vast | Uren: 32–40 uur per week

Ben jij analytisch sterk en lijkt het je interessant om met AI écht impact te maken bij verschillende organisaties? Wil je werken aan projecten waarin strategie, technologie en AI samenkomen? Dan is een carrière als junior AI consultant bij IG&H iets voor jou.

Bij IG&H start je als Junior AI Consultant binnen ons Data & AI-team, onderdeel van onze consultancypraktijk. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen met technologie werkt, maar ook met klanten — van boardroom tot operations. Je leert hoe je AI-oplossingen vertaalt naar concrete toepassingen die organisaties slimmer, efficiënter en innovatiever maken.

Over de werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt klanten in retail, financiële dienstverlening en gezondheidszorg om hun data door middel van AI succesvol in te zetten;

  • Je combineert machine learning, datamodellering en AI met strategisch inzicht;

  • Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar praktische AI-oplossingen;

  • Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams samen met collega-consultants, data scientists en engineers;

  • Je presenteert je inzichten en aanbevelingen op een heldere en overtuigende manier aan klanten;

  • Je ondersteunt organisaties bij AI-adoptie en het realiseren van duurzame verandering;

  • Je leert continu bij via training, coaching en uitdagende projecten.

Kortom: je bouwt niet alleen kennis op van AI en data, maar ontwikkelt ook de adviesvaardigheden die je carrière in de consultancy versnellen.

Over het team

Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en AI-consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf.

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Een masterdiploma (WO-niveau) in Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie of Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Ervaring via een stage of werkstudentschap;

  • Vaardigheid in Python en/of R;

  • Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands & Engels);

  • Interesse in consultancy, technologie en AI;

  • Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en een proactieve houding.

Wat wij jou bieden

  • Coaching on the job door ervaren consultants;

  • Je start vanaf januari 2026;

  • Een uitgebreid ontwikkelprogramma via de IG&H Academy;

  • Een uitstekend salaris, bonusregeling en mobiliteitsregeling of bedrijfsauto;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + tot 5 extra bij te kopen;

  • Healthy Human-programma voor jouw welzijn en balans;

  • Sabbatical na 3 jaar dienstverband;

  • We zijn een Great Place To Work (NPS > 60), en investeren in jouw ontwikkeling vanaf dag één;

  • Flexibiliteit: werken kan ook 32 uur per week (minimaal 4 dagen);

  • Veel plezier met een jong, ambitieus en sociaal team.

Waarom IG&H?

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Samen met onze wereldklasse technologiepartners helpen we onze klanten vooruit te komen en relevant te blijven, met inzichtelijk advies, geweldig ontwerp en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsvoering en technologie. Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s aan boord, mensen die veranderingen en uitdagingen echt omarmen, hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel hoog durft als hoog zorgt. We trekken buitengewone mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.

Interesse?

Klaar om je carrière als AI consultant bij ons te starten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitmentteam via . Je kunt ook direct solliciteren via de sollicitatieknop. We hopen je snel te ontmoeten!

We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in overweging genomen voor een stage of dienstverband, ongeacht nationaliteit, ras, religie, geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, genetica, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een Great Place to Work.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. We werken met preferred suppliers. Stuur ons geen ongevraagde cv’s.

title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer: Software Development & Applied AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse genauso gut wie Code und hast Lust, KI-Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz zu begleiten?

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Umsetzung von Frontends und internen Tools mit TypeScript und React

  • Arbeit mit relationalen Datenbanken: Datenmodelle, SQL und Datenaufbereitung

  • Forward Engineering beim Kunden: Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen aufnehmen, Prototypen schnell bauen und iterativ in produktive Lösungen überführen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Data oder IT-Beratung (z. B. als Werkstudent:in, im Praktikum oder in einer ersten Festanstellung)

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie Erfahrung mit TypeScript und React

  • Sicherer Umgang mit SQL und relationalen Datenbanken

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Modellen, LLM-APIs oder KI-gestützter Entwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Junior HR Business Partner (m/w/d) in Teil- oder Vollzeit
descriptionHtml:
Die allaboutHRLaw GmbH ist ein erfahrenes Beratungsunternehmen für professionelle und praxisnahe Personalarbeit. Als HR as a Service-Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größen und Branchen, insbesondere Start-ups sowie kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen (KMU) bei ihren personalwirtschaftlichen Herausforderungen – flexibel, individuell und bedarfsgerecht.

Ob vollständige Übernahme der Personalarbeit, Unterstützung bei einzelnen HR-Themen oder langfristige Begleitung als externe Personalabteilung: Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die zu den Anforderungen, Strukturen und Entwicklungsphasen unserer Kunden passen. Dabei setzen wir auf partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit, fundiertes Fachwissen und eine nachhaltige Betreuung.

Unser Team aus erfahrenen HR-Profis ist bundesweit tätig, insbesondere in den Regionen Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt am Main, Leipzig, Düsseldorf und München. Unser Standort in Leipzig bildet dabei die zentrale Basis für unsere internen und administrativen Aufgaben.

Zur Verstärkung unseres wachsenden Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen Junior HR Business Partner (m/w/d) in Teil- oder Vollzeit für unseren Standort in Köln.

Was werden Deine Aufgaben sein?

  • Ganzheitliche Betreuung eines definierten Personalbereichs
    Du übernimmst die Betreuung „Deines“ Mitarbeiterkreises, stehst als kompetente:r Ansprechpartner:in für alle personalbezogenen Themen zur Seite und pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.

  • Personalbedarfsermittlung & Recruiting
    Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Recruiting-Maßnahmen, findest passende Talente und sorgst dafür, dass neue Mitarbeitende optimal zu uns und unseren Kunden passen.

  • Begleitung des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses
    Vom ersten Kennenlernen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift: Du führst Vorstellungsgespräche, bereitest Vertragsunterlagen vor und gestaltest einen professionellen und wertschätzenden Auswahlprozess.

  • Beratung von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften
     Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner:in für alle personalwirtschaftlichen und arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei der Umsetzung von HR-relevanten Themen.

  • Mitarbeit an HR-Projekten & Prozessoptimierung
    Ob Digitalisierung, Employer Branding oder interne Abläufe – du bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung unserer HR-Arbeit mit.

  • Unterstützung bei der Entgeltabrechnung
    Du bereitest abrechnungsrelevante Daten auf und arbeitest eng mit unserem Payroll-Team zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.

Was zeichnet Dich aus?

  • Abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Erste relevante Berufserfahrung, gerne auch durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten im HR-Bereich.

  • Kenntnisse in Personalthemen: Du bringst Fachwissen zu Personalprozessen, -themen und arbeitsrechtlichen Grundlagen mit.

  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst Dich gut ausdrücken und berätst sicher auf allen Hierarchieebenen.

  • Hohes Maß an Sozialkompetenz und sicheres Auftreten: Du bist ein Teamplayer, der sich auf verschiedenen Ebenen gut bewegen kann und stets ein professionelles Auftreten pflegt.

Was bieten wir?

  • Raum für Eigeninitiative: Du hast die Möglichkeit, Dich einzubringen und Deine Ideen zu verwirklichen.

  • Steile Lernkurve und enormes Potenzial: Wir bieten Dir die Chance, Dich weiterzuentwickeln und vielfältige Erfahrungen zu sammeln.

  • Flache Hierarchien und direkte Kommunikation: Bei uns zählen Deine Ideen und Dein Input – ohne lange Entscheidungswege.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und individuelle Arbeitszeitmodelle: Wir bieten Dir flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, um Deine beruflichen und privaten Ziele bestmöglich miteinander zu vereinbaren. Die Position ist als Hybridmodell mit einem Vor-Ort-Anteil von mindestens 80 % beim Kunden in Köln ausgestaltet. Die verbleibende Arbeitszeit kann flexibel im Homeoffice erbracht werden.

Wenn Du überzeugt bist, dass Deine Fähigkeiten zu uns passen und Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen, inklusive Angabe des Ortes, des möglichen Eintrittsdatums sowie Deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen.

title: Junior Software Developer - Python & Web Applications (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your team
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.

Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.

With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.

Your Role

  • Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit

  • Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials

  • Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders

  • Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products

Your Profile

  • Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous

  • Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus

  • A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues

  • Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality

  • Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows

  • Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems

What we offer

title: Junior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.

Our technology stack:

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,

React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

  • Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack

Who you are

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both

  • Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Comfortable using Git for version control

  • A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

  • A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out

  • Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging

  • Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team

  • Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend

  • Able to work from our London office at least three days a week

Ideally you'll also have

  • Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI

  • Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker

  • Knowledge of lending products or Open Banking

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Zusätzliche freie Tage an Weihnachten, Silvester und deinem Geburtstag
  • Flexible Mobile-Working-Regelung
  • Regelmäßige und spaßige Team-Events

JAMORIE Consulting GmbH ist ein junges und modernes Beratungsunternehmen mit einer klaren Vision: die Digitalisierung sicher und innovativ voranzutreiben.

Dabei setzt JAMORIE auf Selbstorganisation, Eigenverantwortung, Fairness, Integrität und Innovationsgeist. Perfektion ist nicht das Ziel – im Vordergrund stehen Ausprobieren, Lernen und nachhaltige Lösungen, die einen echten Unterschied machen.

title: Lead Engineer - Stock Trading App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing regional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that accelerates enterprise customer adoption by turning high-impact automation use cases into production-ready workflows. You'll own technical delivery quality, team development, and regional execution, while staying hands-on and empowering customers to become independent, successful builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

Build & Lead a High-Performing FDE Team

  • Set and maintain a high technical quality bar for production workflows, custom nodes, integration architectures, and customer-facing delivery.

Own Regional Delivery & Customer Outcomes

Enable Customers & Scale Technical Excellence

Drive Partner Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regional partner managers and the Partner Delivery Manager to ensure partner-led engagements meet n8n's technical and delivery standards.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, integration gaps, feature requests, and custom node needs into actionable priorities, balancing reusable product improvements with customer-specific solutions.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a regional Forward Deployed Engineering team at a pivotal moment in our enterprise growth journey. You won't just lead engineers — you'll help define how we deliver technical excellence, accelerate customer adoption, and turn ambitious automation ideas into real business outcomes.

You'll combine hands-on technical work with people leadership, working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to influence how we scale customer delivery across your region. Your work will directly contribute to getting more workflows into production, helping customers become independent builders, and creating scalable technical practices that benefit our global FDE organization.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups and a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
  • You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
  • Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Nice to haves: 
    • hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role
The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

descriptionHtml:
About the position

We’re looking for smart and curious individuals from industry and academia to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

On our Machine Learning team, you'll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges— large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques. 

Researchers, engineers and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems and run trading strategies. title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Architecture Case  (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Marketing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

descriptionHtml:

Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid.
