title: Member of Product Staff, Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.

Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust.

We have one value: velocity.

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll design

Day to day, you'll own:

  • the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels

  • interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker

  • the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on

  • fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it

  • the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable

What you'll own

In your first 3–6 months, you should:

  • own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering

  • set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows

  • turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight

  • raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're likely to be excited by people who:

  • have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments

  • are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level

  • have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change

  • care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers

  • want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces

  • design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems

  • AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation

  • a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know — San Francisco

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the SF market: salary plus meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct, and it's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • Simplified leveling: early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games.

  • Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market twice a year and move comp up when it drifts, so "top 10%" stays true after your start date too.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. Raises are tied to a real change in the work, not an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's truly competitive. World-class option grants so we're all owners. The structure stays simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Health, fully covered. 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, for you and your dependents.

  • Unlimited time off. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

title: Network Engineer – Ground Station Networking & Integration
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The challenge

Our operators rely on a ground network that carries telemetry, video and control between drones, antennas and stations, often set up in minutes on unfamiliar terrain. Networking is what turns separate radios, computers and antennas into one system that behaves the same way on every unit. You will configure and debug on the bench, automate deployments, and troubleshoot live links during field trials.

Missions

  • Design the ground network: addressing, routing, switching and power over Ethernet between stations and antenna systems.

  • Integrate telemetry and video flows: MAVLink routing, video streams, latency and reliability measurements.

  • Connect the antenna positioning system to the station: control interface, automatic and manual modes.

  • Automate provisioning: reference images, router configurations, scripts and checklists so every unit is identical.

  • Secure and track deployed systems: workstation hardening, inventory and versions per serial number.

Required skills

  • Degree in networking, computer or embedded engineering, with experience in network deployment or embedded systems.

  • Strong IP networking fundamentals: addressing, VLANs, UDP and multicast, latency and packet-loss diagnostics.

  • Tools: Wireshark, router and switch configuration, Windows and Linux, scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash), Git, Router OS.

  • Clear documentation and cybersecurity basics for sensitive environments.

  • Autonomous and field-oriented, available for frequent travel.

How We Work

title: People & Workplace Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration. The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen.

The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side, you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side, you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door.

What you will be working on:

Own the employee journey

Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one.

  • Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure.

  • Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs.

Build culture and community

  • Running and improving our team rituals, from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings.

  • Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events.

  • Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress, across offices and time zones.

  • Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements.

Shape our workplaces

  • Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us.

  • Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team.

  • Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and handling invoices and expense reports.

Support the founders

  • Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics, and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward.

  • Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup.

  • You are fluent in French and in English.

  • You have warmth and empathy, and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better.

  • You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through.

  • You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning.

  • You are rigorous with admin, and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding.

  • You are very comfortable using AI, and you learn fast.

Nice to have

  • Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad.

  • Experience in people operations in an international company.

  • Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows.

  • Experience working directly with a CEO or founder.

  • Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking).

  • An interest in real estate, architecture or AI.

Why Join Davis

  • Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month.

  • Open our offices abroad, and build how Davis works across countries.

  • Work directly with the founders, in a seat that sees every part of the company.

  • Grow with the company, as the role expands with Davis.

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership.

  • A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs.

More About Davis

The Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar, and we intend to keep it that way.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Tech (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten.

Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. Dabei unterstützt du uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer VR-Anwendungen, beim Testen und Optimieren unserer Software und Hardware, bei KI-Experimenten und der Evaluation neuer VR-Technologien sowie bei der Frage, wie digitale Therapie technisch zuverlässig und sinnvoll in den klinischen Alltag integriert werden kann. Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern arbeitest aktiv an Themen mit, die für Therapeut:innen und Patient:innen einen echten Unterschied machen können.

Tasks

Je nach aktuellen Projekten unterstützt du uns unter anderem bei:

  • der Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung unserer VR-Szenarien in Unity: Du setzt kleinere Features um und behebst Bugs

  • Software Testing & QA: Du testest Szenarien, dokumentierst Bugs und führst Regressionstests durch

  • der Einrichtung und Pflege unserer VR-Hardware: Du setzt Headsets auf, installierst und aktualisierst Software und prüfst, ob alles zuverlässig läuft

  • technischer Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anleitungen, Testprotokolle und Entwicklerdokumentation, damit Wissen im Team nicht verloren geht

  • der Integration und Optimierung von 3D-Assets sowie einfachen Animationen

  • KI-Experimenten: Du evaluierst KI-Tools für 360°-Umgebungen und VR-Inhalte und baust erste Prototypen

  • Performance-Analysen: Du untersuchst Framerate, Ladezeiten und Standalone-Performance

  • Automatisierung: Du schreibst kleine Skripte für Tests und wiederkehrende Prozesse

  • technischem Support: Du reproduzierst Probleme und analysierst technische Fehler

  • Recherchen zu neuen VR-Technologien, Unity-Tools und Integrationen

  • Themen, die im Hintergrund wichtig sind und für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie einen echten Unterschied machen

Requirements

  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Game Development, Software Engineering oder ein vergleichbares Fach

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, bei dem du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern wirklich mitarbeitest

  • Du bringst Programmiergrundlagen in mindestens einer Sprache mit, idealerweise C#

  • Softwareentwicklung, Virtual Reality, DeepTech/ DeepMind und XR findest du spannend

  • Du denkst mit, stellst gute Fragen und möchtest Dinge verstehen und verbessern

  • Struktur, Eigeninitiative und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich und du gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an

  • Du würdest gern in einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team aus Tech, Psychologie und Forschung arbeiten

  • Deutsch und Englisch sind für dich kein Problem, auch für technische Dokumentation

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrungen mit VR Entwicklung gesammelt

  • Erfahrung mit Unity und C#, Meta Quest/OpenXR, Blender oder anderen 3D-Tools, Git, Python, Debugging und Softwaretests oder generativer KI/LLMs ist wünschenswert. Auch Interesse an Digital Health und Psychologie freut uns

  • Dein Lebenslauf muss nicht perfekt sein. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echtes Interesse

Benefits

Bei PsyCurio tauchst du tief in die Welt eines HealthTech-Startups ein, das Psychologie, Virtual Reality, Forschung und MedTech zusammenbringt. Du arbeitest an Themen mit direkter Relevanz für die psychotherapeutische Versorgung und bekommst Einblick in Produktentwicklung, wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und kliniknahe Anwendungen.

Das Praktikum ist unvergütet. Dafür erlebst du das rasante Tempo eines Startups, übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Ideen ein. Die Wege sind kurz, der Austausch ist direkt und du sitzt nicht nur in Meetings, sondern bewegst wirklich etwas.

Du arbeitest bei uns vollständig remote und kannst das Praktikum in Vollzeit für bis zu drei Monate oder entsprechend länger in Teilzeit absolvieren. Abschluss- oder Projektarbeiten sind nach Absprache ebenfalls möglich. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, sprechen wir gern über eine weitere Zusammenarbeit, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in.

Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, bei PsyCurio dabei zu sein, was dich an Virtual Reality, MedTech oder digitaler Gesundheit fasziniert und wie du unser Team unterstützen kannst. Schick uns gern Links zu deinem Portfolio, deinem GitHub-Profil oder einem VR-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist.

title: Platform Engineer (C2)
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Platform Engineer

Team: Platform Engineering

Reporting to: Elinor Ni Chathain (Engineering Manager)

Location: London, Bristol or Edinburgh

Level: C2

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing? 

You’ll play a pivotal role in building and evolving our internal developer platform in order to empower our software teams. Your work will impact how our developers use cloud infrastructure, help teams to eliminate infrastructure toil, improve engineering productivity, reinforce security safeguards and constantly strive for greater cost efficiencies in operations.

  • Engineering Foundations: Engineering a scalable, reliable and developer friendly platform to promote seamless software development, deployment and operations.

  • Automation & Tooling: Develop tools to abstract the complex aspects of the platform from developers to improve developer experience and operational efficiency.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Use tools like Terraform, Helm and Crossplane to manage and automate provisioning of all cloud infrastructure and champion GitOps best practices.

  • Monitoring & Observability: Establish robust monitoring and logging foundations collaborating with the wider Site Reliability Engineering Function.

  • Security & Reliability: Incorporate security best practices, ensure compliance, and participate in the out-of-hours on-call rota to troubleshoot and prevent recurrent issues.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate upgrades and hold service providers accountable.

About You

Ideally you’ll have

  • Experience building and shipping production applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a curiosity to solve problems.

  • Experience using cloud platforms like AWS (preferred), Google Cloud, or Azure.

  • A strong desire to (or experience in) creating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters in production.

  • A solid foundational understanding of distributed systems.

  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code technologies.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with a requirement of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

What will happen next?

Feel free to contact a member of the to discuss the role. More info can be found in our Internal Recruitment Policy.

title: Principal Client Partner
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is a Version 1 company and AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

Our UK Benefits 

  • 35 days leave (including bank holidays). 
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Enhanced parental and adoption leave. 
  • Financial coaching + 5% pension match.
  • 40 hours of paid learning and development.

 View our full list of UK benefits.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 

Our Client Partners are at the heart of our client relationships, and our focus is on growing them, not just maintaining them. As Principal Client Partner, you'll own some of CreateFuture's most strategically important client relationships and lead a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners. This is a senior commercial leadership role: you'll set the growth agenda across a portfolio of accounts, build trusted relationships at C-suite level, and turn those relationships into significant, sustained revenue.

You'll be the person our clients call when they're thinking about what's next, and the person our team looks to for how growth gets done. You'll shape how CreateFuture grows its client base, from account strategy and multi-competitor bids through to commercial planning, and lead by example in the behaviours that drive it: qualifying with rigour, following through with intent, and seeing commercial conversations through to an outcome.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning the commercial performance of a portfolio of our largest or most strategically important accounts, from opportunity identification through to close, with clear accountability for revenue, margin and growth targets.
  • Building and sustaining C-suite relationships (CEO, CTO, CDO), expanding the stakeholder map, identifying whitespace and needs before clients articulate them, and turning those conversations into multi-workstream programmes.
  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners, raising the whole team's capability in consultative selling, stakeholder strategy and commercial qualification.
  • Leading CreateFuture's approach to large, complex and multi-competitor bids, shaping value propositions, particularly across AI, data and modern digital delivery, that position us as the partner of choice.
  • Setting the operational rhythm across multiple portfolios: holding a 3x pipeline standard, driving forecast accuracy and high-quality Statements of Work, and owning your contribution to annual financial targets and wider commercial planning.
  • Championing strategic account planning and Client Partnership Groups (CPGs), aligning delivery teams to client expectations, using client satisfaction as a lever for growth, and raising CreateFuture's profile through events, content and thought leadership.


We’d love to talk to you if you:  

  • Have significant experience leading accounts in consultancy, professional services or digital and technology delivery, with a track record of growing large accounts materially through your own commercial judgement and relationship moves, not just retaining them.
  • Take full ownership of your numbers: you understand pipeline coverage, qualify with discipline, forecast accurately without being chased, and are comfortable leading commercial conversations early, often and at C-suite level.
  • Bring real credibility on AI and technology: you can hold a commercially grounded conversation with a CTO, CDO or CEO about agentic AI, data, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern software delivery, and have successfully positioned AI-related propositions.
  • Have led and developed client-facing teams, building commercial instinct and discipline in others and creating repeatable ways of working that scale across accounts.
  • Think strategically and act decisively: you spot opportunity, assess risk, bring senior client and internal stakeholders on the journey with you, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not activity.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Principal Payments Architect
descriptionHtml:
Principal Payments Architect

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Lead innovative payments transformation across financial services.

About Capco

Capco is a global leader in technology and business consulting, dedicated to driving digital innovation and transformation in financial services. We’ve partnered with over 100 clients worldwide - from pioneering FinTech's to established global institutions - helping them adapt, compete, and scale in a rapidly evolving industry. With more than 30 offices globally, we combine deep expertise in banking, payments, capital markets, insurance, wealth and asset management, and energy with an agile, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture.

Role Overview

You will play a central role in shaping and delivering some of our clients' most critical payments transformation programmes, applying your expertise in enterprise and solution architecture alongside your deep knowledge of payments. You will help modernise core payment platforms and enable new digital payment capabilities while guiding clients through complex regulatory, operational, and technology change. Your work will influence how banks and financial institutions build, operate, and innovate across domestic and international payment ecosystems.

Working closely with engineers, you will design scalable and resilient payment solutions while helping senior stakeholders shape long-term payments strategies and investment decisions. You will also lead high-performing teams, mentor junior technologists, and contribute to the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through thought leadership, community engagement, and supporting new client opportunities. You'll be encouraged to adopt approved AI-enabled tools and automation to enhance architecture design, accelerate analysis, improve documentation quality and support more informed decision-making, while applying appropriate human judgement, governance and responsible AI principles.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the architecture and modernisation of complex payment platforms across domestic, international, real-time, on-us and card payment ecosystems, delivering scalable, resilient and secure solutions.
  • Define payments technology strategies, target architectures and transformation roadmaps while working closely with business, engineering and delivery teams to guide implementation and investment decisions.
  • Apply modern architecture practices including microservices, event-driven design, cloud-native technologies and DevOps, leveraging approved AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve productivity, design quality and delivery outcomes while maintaining human oversight.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, mentor technical teams and contribute to Capco's Technology & Engineering community through thought leadership and business development.
  • Ensure architectural decisions align with regulatory requirements, security, resilience, governance and responsible AI principles where AI-enabled capabilities form part of the solution landscape.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience designing or modernising payment platforms across Faster Payments, Bacs, CHAPS, SWIFT, SEPA, Open Banking, ISO 20022 and related payment ecosystems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise and solution architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, modern engineering practices and recognised frameworks such as TOGAF and Domain-Driven Design.
  • Strong consulting, stakeholder management and leadership experience with the ability to influence senior technology and business decision-makers.
  • Experience delivering large-scale payments transformation programmes using agile delivery methodologies and modern engineering practices.
  • A curiosity for AI-enabled ways of working and an understanding of how approved AI tools, automation and responsible AI governance can improve architectural delivery while maintaining appropriate review, auditability and human judgement.

Bonus Points For

  • Senior consulting experience delivering large-scale payments transformation programmes.
  • Experience leading pre-sales engagements, proposals and commercial estimates.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies including digital wallets, tokenisation, embedded finance and AI (including Generative AI and Agentic AI), AI-driven fraud detection and intelligent automation within payment ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of financial crime, AML controls, payment fraud prevention and security architecture.
  • Exposure to international payment ecosystems and relevant architecture or cloud certifications such as TOGAF or AWS.

Why Join Capco?

At Capco, you’ll be part of a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture working with Tier 1 financial services enterprises on impactful and enriching projects. We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package to support your growth as both a technologist and a consultant.

Our benefits include:

  • Core benefits: discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health and dental insurance, life insurance, and critical illness cover.
  • Mental health: access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-friendly: maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell days.
  • Continuous learning: minimum 40 hours of annual training, including workshops, certifications, e-learning, and ongoing business coaching.
  • Extra perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, and Cycle to Work scheme.

Inclusion at Capco
We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward. If you need adjustments at any stage, please let us know. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration—a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: Principal Software Architect
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role Overview

Role:

We are looking for a Principal Software Architect to join our Compute Software organisation at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the architecture of the software that enables a quantum computer, from low level hardware control up to developer programming interfaces, contributing to the team’s mission of delivering a complete software product for a quantum computer.

You’ll play an important part in shaping the software and tools that support our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems. Our architecture now needs to evolve to support the next generation of our systems, and you will lead that work.

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will develop the software architecture covering real-time and non-real-time hardware management, low level orchestration and user interfaces for the current product and the future roadmap of products. You will also work with the technical leads from the development teams to support the effective development and delivery of a scalable solution that supports internal experimental scientists and external customers.

You’ll have the opportunity to develop an evolving software architecture to support a family of products, contributing directly to the success of the system software team in delivering a world leading quantum computer. You will coach and train technical leads in good architectural principles, and work closely with the infrastructure, firmware and compiler teams across the UK and the US.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Development and documentation of the system software architecture
  • Managing the evolving architecture across a family of products
  • Coordination with other architects across the whole of software and the wider system
  • Research and analysis to support future requirements elucidation
  • Coordination with technical leads to ensure that the design and implementation meets the intention of the architecture

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need prior experience of developing a large and scalable software architecture covering real-time requirements and distributed processing. We’re looking for someone who can think strategically at the architecture level, solve challenging technical issues, track the latest industry good practice and tools, and communicate those ideas and technologies to the wider software team.

You will work at the level of the whole system, describing each component, what it does and its constraints, and then handing the detailed design and implementation to the development teams rather than designing through code. A grounding in formal architecture methods and principles such as cohesion, coupling and encapsulation will help you succeed, as will experience of evolving an architecture that has to grow with the product. Our immediate focus is system software and lower level control; experience further up the software stack is an advantage.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • More than 10 years of software development experience, with more than 5 as a software architect
  • A clear understanding of software architecture principles
  • A background in real-time software development
  • Experience working on software projects written in Rust

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
The role

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities

Build and ship

  • Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production
  • Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation
  • Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call
  • Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction

  • Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured
  • Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit
  • Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design

  • Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity
  • Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin
  • Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works

  • Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working

  • Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes
  • Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise

AI-native engineering

  • Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace
  • Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows
  • Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release
  • Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails
  • Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders
  • Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations

  • Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating
  • Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores
  • Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry
  • Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building

  • Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop
  • Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills

  • Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets
  • Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value
  • Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer
  • Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person
  • Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated
Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Process Development Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un(e) Process Development Senior Manager autonome pour poursuivre la recherche et la production de nanoparticules qui pourront aider des millions de patients à travers le monde. Notre recherche innovante est en plein développement et offre une expérience unique.

Depuis notre création, notre équipe s'est engagée dans la recherche et le développement de méthodes disruptives en nanomédecine qui pourraient révolutionner la manière dont de nombreux cancers sont traités.

Nanobiotix conçoit et fabrique des nanoparticules qui améliorent en toute sécurité l'efficacité de la radiothérapie dans le traitement du cancer. Nous croyons que la radiothérapie combinée avec le NBTXR3 peut devenir une nouvelle norme de soins dans le traitement du cancer.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir et développer des procédés de fabrication avec une approche Quality by Design (QbD).
  • Développer ou adapter des procédés de fabrication permettant la production à petite échelle pour les études non-cliniques.

  • Encadrer et accompagner les membres de l’équipe dans leurs activités de développement procédé.

  • Expertise en développement de procédés et en ingénierie des procédés à petite échelle.

  • Maîtrise des concepts Quality by Design, design space, attributs qualité critiques et paramètres procédés critiques.

  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement transverse et multidisciplinaire.
  • Communication claire, structurée et factuelle.
  • Esprit collaboratif et sens des responsabilités.

Formation et expérience

Nanobiotix propose une rémunération fixe et variable, ainsi que divers avantages tels qu’une mutuelle, une prévoyance, un plan d'épargne retraite, des titres-restaurant et des indemnités de transport.

title: Product Designer - London
descriptionHtml:
As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

  • Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

  • Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

  • Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

  • Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

  • Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

  • Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

  • Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

  • Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

  • Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

  • Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

  • Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

  • Are fluent in Figma.

  • Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

  • Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces.

  • Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us.

If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our London office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

  • Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.

  • Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.

It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.

You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.

DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?

We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law.

title: Product Manager - F/H
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent.

  • Tu pilotes la conception et la delivery. En collaboration avec les designers et les équipes techniques, tu animes le cycle de vie produit (backlog, roadmap, story mapping) avec une rigueur orientée valeur.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur.

  • Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.

  • Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 41.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.


👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. Ou tu es PO confirmé avec une vraie volonté de progresser vers une posture PM complète (discovery, stratégie, pilotage d'impact).

  • Tu es à l'aise avec le pilotage de backlog, la roadmap et tu possèdes une culture data marquée. Ton orientation valeur est ton moteur au quotidien.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

  • Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

  • Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

  • Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

  • Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.
