descriptionHtml:
Ready to design products and services that make a difference?

Do you want to create products that make a meaningful impact? Are you ready to lead strategy and delivery on projects that reach large audiences?

If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Product Manager, you’ll lead product strategy and delivery, balancing user needs and business goals across sectors, to create services that are used by millions of UK citizens.

The role

You’ll work with technical teams and stakeholders to develop solutions that deliver our clients’ strategic goals. You'll work in agile teams alongside people in a range of roles spanning design, development, and research.

You’ll help deliver the vision, helping to decide the features that each product needs and manage backlogs to meet our client preferences. You'll deliver discovery and ideation workshops across diverse groups of stakeholders.

Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site working. Applicants should be able to travel, as part of their daily commute, to client sites in one of the following locations: Newcastle, Leeds or Manchester.

We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process.

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

We’re looking to welcome new team members for multiple roles from November onward. If you’re interested in joining Opencast, we’d encourage you to apply.

Essential experience

To succeed as a senior consultant product manager, you will need to demonstrate a breadth and depth of experience working in product management roles, on complex projects, across the full product lifecycle in different sectors.


You will have in-depth knowledge of software development, with experience in agile and user-centred design.


In your CV and the interview, you should show how you have:
  • Led cross-functional, agile teams to deliver successful products
  • Developed product visions, minimum viable products and roadmaps, understanding business problems and contexts
  • Communicated objectives, plans and progress to a range of stakeholders
  • Used boundary objects to synthesise many different perspectives
  • Facilitated conversations to align large groups of diverse stakeholders
  • Cultivated high performing, constructive and trusting team environments

With a significant proportion of our client base in the public sector, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience working in central or local government and/or the NHS.

Experience working to the GOV.UK Service Standards, including passing service standard assessments at different stages, is a desirable skill. If you have this experience, please demonstrate this on your CV to discuss at interview.

Essential consulting skills

In addition to business analysis skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

  • Contribute to improving ways of working and driving continuous improvements within your teams.
  • Share knowledge and best practice with fellow product managers and other disciplines, including proactively engaging in client and Opencast communities of practice.
  • Positively challenge decisions or solutions you don’t agree with, striving for the best client outcomes.
  • Create lasting value in the projects you work on, ensuring a user-centric, sustainable approach.

£60,000 - £70,000 per annum.

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.

title: Product Marketing Manager - Care Providers & Health
descriptionHtml:
Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, site or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Care homes and clinics sit among our priority sectors.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on health, starting with groups that run several care homes, clinics or practices, and work out how Light wins there.

These groups carry the finance problems of any multi-entity business, plus funding models, regulation and workflows of their own. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across the sector.

You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with our Care and Health Sales Managers, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how care home groups and clinics buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

  • Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

  • Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of an operator or a finance director.

  • Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak the sector’s language.

  • Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, workflows and vocabulary of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

  • Bringing the sector’s requirements back to Product, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

  • Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

  • Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

  • A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

  • Experience in health, care or a closely related sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with operators matter more.

  • Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

  • Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a deal.

  • An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

  • Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever care homes and clinics do business.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in a sector from its first deals.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Care home groups and clinics run complex businesses on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn the sector inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there.

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Stockbroking
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Projektmanager Instandhaltung und Sanierung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie kommen vom Bau oder aus dem Handwerk, erkennen auf den ersten Blick, ob eine Arbeit sauber ausgeführt ist, und wollen Maßnahmen nicht mehr selbst ausführen, sondern voranbringen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Die Immobetriebe Hausverwaltung GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen in Konstanz. Wir verwalten Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften, Mietshäuser und größere Gewerbeobjekte im Raum Konstanz, Radolfzell und Singen. Wir arbeiten weitgehend digital: ein Vorgangssystem für alle Fälle, KI-Assistenz bei Routinen und Abläufe, die wir aufschreiben und gemeinsam verbessern.

Bisher haben unsere Verwalter die Umsetzung von Instandhaltung und Sanierung neben ihren rechtlichen Aufgaben mitgetragen. Diese Aufgabe lösen wir jetzt heraus und machen sie zu einer eigenen Stelle, die eng mit den Verwaltern zusammenarbeitet: Die Verwaltung führt Versammlung und Beschluss, Sie bringen die beschlossenen Maßnahmen auf die Baustelle und zum Abschluss.

Als Projektkoordinator sorgen Sie dafür, dass Instandhaltung und Sanierung in unseren Objekten zügig, in guter Qualität und im beschlossenen Budget umgesetzt werden. Die Ausführung liegt bei unseren Fachfirmen. Sie vertreten die Eigentümer als Bauherr: Sie planen, beauftragen, prüfen und halten nach, bis die Maßnahme abgenommen ist.

Aufgaben

  • Sie sehen sich Schäden und Instandhaltungsbedarf vor Ort an und schätzen ein, was zu tun ist und welche Gewerke gebraucht werden

  • Sie besprechen Umbau- und Modernisierungswünsche von Eigentümern am Objekt und machen daraus ein umsetzbares Vorhaben

  • Sie holen Angebote ein, vergleichen sie und bereiten Entscheidungen vor; Umfang, Varianten und Kosten liefern Sie für die Beschlüsse der Eigentümer, den Beschluss selbst holt die Verwaltung ein

  • Steht der Beschluss, setzen Sie die Maßnahme um: Sie beauftragen die Firmen, setzen Termine, koordinieren die Gewerke und halten nach, bis alles erledigt ist

  • Sie prüfen vor Ort, ob fachgerecht gearbeitet wird, nehmen Leistungen ab, verfolgen Mängel und prüfen Rechnungen gegen den Auftrag

  • Sie arbeiten im Rahmen der Budgets und Freigaben, die Beschlüsse und Verwaltervertrag vorgeben, und melden Abweichungen frühzeitig

  • Sie dokumentieren jedes Projekt im Vorgangssystem und erfassen Ihre Zeiten laufend

  • Ein großer Teil Ihrer Arbeit findet am Schreibtisch statt: Telefon, E-Mail, Angebote und Abstimmung mit Eigentümern, Beirat und Verwaltung

Qualifikation

  • Eine bautechnische Ausbildung, etwa im Handwerk, als Techniker oder ein Studium im Bauwesen, und mehrjährige Praxis am Bau oder in der Instandhaltung von Gebäuden

  • Ein gutes Auge für Qualität über mehrere Gewerke hinweg; Sie erkennen, was ein Schaden braucht und was ein Angebot taugt

  • Freude daran, Dinge zu Ende zu bringen und mehrere Maßnahmen gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten

  • Verlässlichkeit im Umgang mit Budgets und Freigaben

  • Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation: Projektstand und Zeiten schreiben Sie konsequent auf

  • Ein freundliches, klares Auftreten gegenüber Eigentümern und Handwerkern

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365; Offenheit für digitale Werkzeuge und KI im Alltag

  • Führerschein Klasse B und verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • WEG-Recht müssen Sie nicht mitbringen. Die rechtliche Seite verantwortet die Verwaltung, Sie lernen sie im Alltag kennen

Benefits

  • Eigene Projekte von der Besichtigung bis zur Abnahme, mit klaren Vorgaben und Rückhalt im Team

  • Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Objekten in der Region, planbare Arbeitszeiten statt Baustellenalltag

  • Dienstfahrzeuge für Fahrten zu den Objekten

  • Betriebliche Zusatzleistungen und Weiterbildung

title: Public Sector Sales Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there
  • Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice
  • Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion
  • Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP
  • Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation
  • Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements
  • Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages
  • Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn
  • Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government
  • The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset
  • Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place
  • A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal
  • A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams
  • Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes
  • Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers
  • Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues
  • Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it
  • The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials
  • Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both
  • Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it 
  • A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions

À propos du poste

En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.

Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. La première année, la réussite se mesurera moins à un grand chiffre qu'à votre capacité à installer Anthropic auprès de l'État français : une stratégie claire, les bonnes fondations et nos premiers accords stratégiques.

Responsabilités

  • Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains d'action, nos leviers de succès et ce qu'il nous faut construire pour y parvenir
  • Incarner Anthropic au plus haut niveau auprès de l'État français, en nouant des relations de confiance avec les cabinets ministériels, les cadres dirigeants de l'administration et les responsables du numérique et de la technologie des plus grands ministères, dont la défense, les finances et la justice
  • Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension
  • Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de partenariat, accords-cadres et centrales d'achat telles que l'UGAP
  • Collaborer au quotidien avec notre responsable des affaires publiques en France, pour que les démarches commerciales et politiques se renforcent mutuellement, en cohérence avec la stratégie et la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'IA
  • Mener les échanges clients sur la souveraineté des données, la sécurité et la conformité (par exemple SecNumCloud et la doctrine « cloud au centre »), et travailler avec les équipes Sécurité, Juridique et Produit sur la façon dont nous répondons à ces exigences
  • Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps
  • Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements
  • Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France

Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez

  • Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française
  • L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ
  • Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore
  • Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation
  • Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques
  • Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente
  • Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients
  • L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles
  • Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction
  • La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau
  • Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues
  • La disponibilité pour engager une procédure d'habilitation de sécurité si certains comptes l'exigent
  • Un engagement sincère en faveur d'une IA sûre et bénéfique, et la capacité d'expliquer pourquoi cela compte pour les institutions publiques

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Real Estate Transaction Lead, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the EMEA region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets.

Neko is opening clinics at pace: the plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens across EMEA and a global portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade.

The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States and EMEA, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across EMEA markets including the UK, Germany, the Nordics, and other major European cities. Markets are TBD and could extend across the region depending on demand.

  • Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the EMEA region.

  • LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution.

  • Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny.

  • Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the EMEA region.

  • Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards.

  • Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout.

  • Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 to 7 years of real estate transaction experience, with meaningful time spent in-house at a healthcare, wellness, or high-growth retail company.

  • You have personally led deals end to end, from site identification through LOI to signed lease, in competitive markets.

  • Comfort working in a startup environment with real pressure, fast timelines, and limited infrastructure. You build as you go.

  • A self-starter who does not need a fully defined playbook to do great work.

  • Strong communication skills. You can represent Neko professionally with institutional landlords while keeping internal stakeholders informed concisely.

  • Ability to read and pressure-test lease terms, rent schedules, and deal economics. You do not need to build financial models from scratch, but you need to know when a deal works and when it does not.

  • Familiarity with GIS tools and lease administration platforms is a plus; willingness to learn them quickly is a must.

  • AI: We use AI tools including Claude in daily work and expect you to use them too.

  • Based in Europe, within reasonable travel of the markets you cover. Experience working across multiple countries and lease regimes is a plus.

title: AP/AR Assistant
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an Accounts Payable and Receivable Assistant to keep our day-to-day payables and receivables accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You will own the detail of supplier invoice processing, customer invoicing, and cash allocation, follow our financial controls, and raise blockers early. Your work allows the wider team to move quickly without losing financial discipline.

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with budget owners, procurement, commercial teams, and colleagues across the business who supply approvals and billing information. The role suits someone who takes pride in accuracy, is comfortable working to regular deadlines, and knows when to escalate an issue rather than leave it unresolved.

What You Will Do

  • Process supplier invoices end to end, including checking that they are complete and approved, coding them correctly, and posting them promptly across the entities you support.

  • Raise customer invoices promptly once approved billing inputs are received, and keep billing accurate and well documented.

  • Allocate customer receipts to the correct accounts quickly, and investigate and resolve unidentified payments.

  • Prepare and complete AP and AR reconciliations by the agreed monthly deadline, supporting a clean and timely month-end close.

  • Investigate differences and unusual items, and escalate anything that remains unexplained to the appropriate owner without delay.

  • Keep the approvals and supporting evidence required for every transaction you handle, so that records are complete for internal review and external audit.

  • Review overdue payables and receivables each week, assign an owner and next action to each overdue item, and follow up until it is resolved.

  • Respond to queries from suppliers, customers, and internal colleagues on invoices, payments, and account balances.

  • Follow documented procedures and financial controls, and suggest improvements where you see ways to make processes more accurate or efficient.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience processing accounts payable and accounts receivable, including reconciliations.

  • A high standard of accuracy and close attention to detail, particularly in coding and data entry.

  • A good understanding of financial controls, with sound judgement about what to approve, query, or escalate.

  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, with the ability to meet recurring deadlines and keep many items moving at once.

  • Clear written and spoken communication, including raising issues promptly and explaining them concisely.

  • Working knowledge of accounting systems and strong spreadsheet skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting month-end close and audit requests.

  • Experience working across multiple legal entities or currencies.

  • Experience in a fast-growing or scaling business.

  • A qualification or part-qualification in accounting or finance.

title: Buchhalter*in Fintech (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Freelance Copy Editor

Remote | £5.20 per editorial | Contract until February 2027

About the opportunity

We’re looking for experienced freelance Copy Editors to support our EMEA research and editorial team during a busy part of our publication cycle.

You’ll review and refine written assessments produced by our researchers, helping to ensure that our editorial content is accurate, consistent and easy to read. title: Customer Success Architect, France
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Architect, you’ll sit at the intersection of business outcomes and technical excellence, helping customers align GitLab’s DevSecOps platform with their strategic goals. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to key accounts, using your deep understanding of Git, CI/CD, software development lifecycles, and DevSecOps practices to guide them through complex challenges and drive adoption, utilization, and maturity across the GitLab platform. You’ll own a book of customers, translate pre-sales command plans into actionable success plans, and partner closely with Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to ensure issues are resolved, value is realized, and long-term relationships grow.

In this role, you’ll focus on the themes of align, enable, and expand: aligning our solutions to customer objectives, enabling teams through hands-on technical onboarding and best-practice guidance, and expanding value as customers progress on their GitLab journey. In your first year, you’ll be expected to build strong, consultative relationships, increase product adoption and customer satisfaction within your accounts, and become the go-to liaison for questions, escalations, and roadmap conversations.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with customers to translate pre-sales command plans into clear, actionable objectives tied to their desired business outcomes.
  • Guide customers on how to best use the GitLab platform, applying DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Git best practices across common use cases.
  • Lead customers through their adoption journey, from onboarding and enablement to ongoing utilization and maturity of the platform.
  • Own a portfolio of customers, focusing on driving product adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction.
  • Act as the primary GitLab liaison for your accounts, coordinating with Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services on questions, issues, roadmaps, and escalations.
  • Build and maintain Customer Success Plans with assigned customers, defining critical goals and key performance indicators, and track progress against those goals.
  • Program manage account escalations, ensuring timely coordination, communication, and resolution across GitLab teams and customer stakeholders.
  • Stay current on GitLab releases and new features, and proactively provide insights and recommendations on how customers can use them to achieve their objectives.
  • Identify and recommend training and services opportunities that support customer enablement and long-term success.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles with a focus on driving adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Ability to act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders, partnering with customers to define, prioritize, and achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, effective presentations, and the ability to explain technical topics to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated project management capabilities, including organizing work, managing escalations, and coordinating across internal teams such as Support, Product Management, Sales, and Services.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret customer data, identify risks or opportunities, and recommend actionable next steps.
  • Comfort working both independently and as part of a distributed team, with attention to detail and alignment to GitLab’s values.
  • Openness to travel as needed and to apply transferable skills from related roles or industries in support of customer success and technical enablement.
  • Fluent French

About the team

The Customer Success Architect team focuses on hands-on technical enablement, adoption, utilization, and maturity of the GitLab DevSecOps platform while maintaining strong, consultative customer relationships and business alignment. You’ll work as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team that collaborates asynchronously with Customer Success Managers, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support to act as a trusted advisor for customers. Our mission is to align GitLab capabilities with customer business outcomes, guide them along their adoption journey, and help them navigate complex technical and organizational change so they realize long-term value from GitLab. For more on how our team works, see the Team Handbook Page.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.

This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

In this role you will

  • Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

  • Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.

  • Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.

  • Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.

  • Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines.

  • Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment.

  • Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big.

  • Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions.

  • Deep deal structuring experience. You have personally designed and negotiated creative commercial structures and know how to make the economics work for both sides while protecting the business.

  • Executive presence. You are credible with C-suite executives at the largest enterprises in the world and can hold the room alongside our CRO and CEO.

  • Comfort outside the playbook. You thrive in deals that don't follow a standard process, and you know when to break the playbook and when to rely on it.

  • Cross-functional orchestration. You can rally Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and executives around a deal when none of them report to you, and you do it by being prepared, decisive, and easy to work with.

  • Business case and value fluency. You can build a credible, quantified business case tied to customer outcomes and defend it to a CFO.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You understand pricing, margin, and long-term account economics, and you know the difference between a big deal and a good deal.

  • Technical fluency. You understand AI and platform products well enough to shape solution design and hold your own with a customer's CTO.

  • Operator mentality. You care about what happens after signature, and you make sure what we sold gets deployed successfully.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable leading pursuits with teams and customers across AMER, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and India.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 40% of the time, often with customers' and ElevenLabs' executives.

Bonus points

  • Experience building or leading a strategic pursuits, strategic deals, or global accounts function at a high-growth AI, cloud, or enterprise software company.

  • Experience selling AI, voice, conversational AI, or platform/API products to large enterprises.

  • Experience structuring partnerships, marketplace, or co-sell agreements alongside direct deals.

  • Experience in a company where the product and the market move weekly and deals have to keep up.

Location

This is a remote global role within the Revenue organization. You will travel up to 50% for

customer and executive meetings and for working sessions with regional sales leadership.

You’ll manage a team of advocates, but this isn’t a desk job. You’ll still give talks, run workshops, write code, and sit down with customers yourself. If it’s been a while since you built a demo from scratch, this probably isn’t the right fit.

  • Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences.

  • Decide how the team splits its time between community and customer work. Sort incoming customer requests by deal size, stage, and strategic value, and make the tough calls when there’s more demand than people, without letting community work get pushed aside.

  • Work with Marketing to plan where we show up in EMEA: which conferences to speak at and which meetups to start or support.

  • Create and localize content that developers in the region will use, like talks, tutorials, blog posts, videos, sample apps, and livestreams.

  • Find the people in local communities who care about the problems Temporal solves and help them lead, contribute to open source, and spread the word.

  • Track whether it’s working: are more developers signing up, trying Temporal, and sticking around?

  • Own DevDays, our onsite customer engagement program, in EMEA from start to finish. Work with the Global DevDays lead to tailor each one to the customer’s use cases.

  • Spot the engineers inside each account who could become champions, and make sure someone follows up with them.

  • Take what you hear from developers and customers back to Docs, Education, and Product, especially around language, data residency, and what different markets need.

  • Experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, developer education, or technical community work, ideally in a developer-first company.

  • People leadership experience or a clear readiness to step into it; you can coach senior individual contributors while still doing the work yourself.

  • Strong hands-on technical credibility: you can build, demo, and teach, and earn the respect of senior enterprise engineers.

  • An operational, execution-first mindset: you can run a repeatable program, manage intake and prioritization, and keep commitments against an SLA.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, SAs, Dev Success, Product, and Marketing, and translating technical engagement into commercial impact.

  • Experience operating across a linguistically and culturally diverse region and coordinating a distributed team across multiple time zones; additional European languages are a plus.

title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

  • Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

  • Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

  • Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.


What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.

  • A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

  • The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.

  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.

  • Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.

  • Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.

  • A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.

  • Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.

  • Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks.

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.

Requirements

title: Strategic Project Lead - Speech & Audio AI (London)
descriptionHtml:

The Strategic Project Lead – Speech & Audio will sit in Appen's Operations organization and support the development of frontier AI through high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in speech, audio, or language data to own complex projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll combine project management, domain expertise, and quality ownership to help clients build and improve speech recognition systems, voice agents, and other AI applications. You’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to solve problems, refine workflows, and keep pace with a rapidly evolving AI landscape.


Your Impact
  • Own end-to-end delivery across project scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.
  • Manage client communication, status updates, workshops, and escalations.
  • Translate client requirements into annotation guidelines, workflows, tooling, and quality standards.
  • Define and monitor quality metrics, including transcription accuracy, word error rate (WER), diarization, and linguistic consistency.
  • Troubleshoot quality issues and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.
  • Provide domain expertise across speech and audio workflows, advising on feasibility, evaluation methods, and tooling.
  • Build reusable guidelines, SOPs, and QA frameworks while mentoring Operations Specialists.
  • Support new project scoping, pilots, and capability development as speech and voice AI evolves.

    • What You Bring
  • 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.
  • Hands-on familiarity with at least one speech, audio, language, or conversational AI workflow.
  • Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.
  • Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.
  • Ability to turn client requirements into clear guidelines, workflows, and quality standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Interest in current AI developments and how speech, audio, and voice-agent technologies are evolving.

    • Nice to Have
  • Experience with ASR transcription, speaker diarization, acoustic annotation, or TTS evaluation.
  • Familiarity with voice-agent scripts, IVR, dialogue design, turn-taking, or conversational evaluation.
  • Experience with localization, cross-locale consistency, CJK languages, or low-resource languages.
  • Bilingual or multilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

    • Why You'll Love Working Here

    At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

    You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.


    About Appen
    Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.
