title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
descriptionHtml:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools they use, you'll turn what each review teaches us into shared components, conventions, tests and agent instructions. Over time the whole practice becomes more predictable, and each new branch arrives closer to production-ready.

Roles and collaboration

Software development roles are blurring more than ever. This role reports to product design, with API and data-layer guidance from our control plane engineering lead. You must be attuned to the perspectives of both UX/Design and Engineering, acting as a bridge between the goals and priorities of both sides, while ultimately deferring to UX/design partners on matters of style, copy, and information architecture.

In practice: when a designer's branch makes a choice about layout, copy or flow, you protect the intent and fix the implementation. When the implementation can't support the intent, because of performance, data shape or maintainability, you say so early and bring options rather than quietly changing the design.

What you'll do

  • Review designer-authored merge requests and bring them to production quality: structure, types, tests, accessibility, performance, and both light and dark themes.

  • Turn one-off UI from fast iteration into shared, documented components in our design system and Storybook, and migrate the apps onto them.

  • Make data-dense views hold up at real scale. Dashboards, tables, charts, and time-range and filter controls that work on a demo tenant also have to work on one with billions of events.

  • Wire UI to the API layer (GraphQL), and work with backend developers when a view needs a new query, field or endpoint.

  • Own UI test coverage: Vitest for units and Playwright for end-to-end flows, kept green in CI.

  • Test UI end to end in live, secured environments, with full authentication and authorization, real data and realistic load, before calling it done.

  • Keep UI work moving across release lines: shipping behind feature flags, and carrying fixes between branches when a release is frozen.

  • Fix UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac and Linux clients: layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing.

  • When needed, design new interfaces within the existing design system, and bring them to design for review.

  • Help set the guardrails that make AI-assisted UI development safe: lint rules, conventions, review checklists, and the instructions our AI coding tools follow.

How we expect you to work

These are the habits of a careful engineer. They matter more here, not less, because so much of the code you touch was drafted quickly by someone else or by an AI tool.

  1. Diagnose before you change. Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix.

  2. Small, deliberate diffs. Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later.

  3. Fix it in one place. When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill.

  4. Verify, then claim. Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, and write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it.

  5. Say when you're unsure. A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review.

Our UI stack and design system

Our front ends are several React and TypeScript apps that share one codebase: our enterprise operator consoles and our cloud product for builders.

All of them are built on our own design system. It is a shared React component library on top of Ant Design, with design tokens for color, type and spacing, light and dark themes, and a shared app shell for navigation, page layout and headers. Every component is documented in Storybook, published from CI, which serves as the reference for designers, engineers and AI coding tools alike. The library also carries written instructions for AI coding assistants, so generated code reaches for the system's components and tokens instead of inventing its own.

A large part of this role is the design system itself. That means promoting patterns out of individual apps into shared components, writing their stories, keeping tokens and themes consistent so the apps don't drift, and making the system the easiest path for anyone, or any agent, building UI.

  • Front end: React, TypeScript, Vite

  • Design system: our component library built on Ant Design, including design tokens and light and dark themes

  • Documentation: Storybook, published to GitLab Pages

  • Data and charts: GraphQL; ECharts for the data-dense views

  • Testing: Vitest, Playwright, and contract and smoke suites in CI

  • Delivery: GitLab merge requests and pipelines, release branches, feature flags

  • Further back: TypeScript and Rust services over graph and columnar stores, built on OpenTelemetry, plus desktop apps and services across Mac, Windows and Linux

You don't need experience with all of it. You do need to be strong in TypeScript and React, and willing to read code before changing it.

What you bring

  • About 3–5 years building production front ends in TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens.

  • An end-to-end view of the systems behind the UI. Designing in code gets a feature most of the way to working, and you close the rest of the gap. For you, “done” doesn’t stop at the UI working. It means the UI is integrated and shown to work live, in a secured environment with full authentication and authorization, under realistic load.

  • Integration testing against complex backends. Tests that only run against mock data in a standalone dev stack aren’t enough here. You can create, integrate and run tests in live environments to check data validity, load, security and scale, and you keep unit, integration and end-to-end suites green in CI.

  • Performance instincts for data-heavy UI: pagination, virtualization, server-side filtering, and knowing when a slow page is a query problem rather than a rendering problem.

  • A track record of reviewing other people’s code and improving it without rewriting it.

  • Git in complex repositories with several active release branches, where a single fix may need to be cherry-picked, ported or graft-merged onto more than one of them. Readable commits, and responding to review without taking it personally.

  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools in real work, with clear habits for checking what they produce.

  • CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, and why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped.

  • Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, ideally with Storybook and design tokens.

  • Careful attention to visual detail and real interest in UX. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing.

  • Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates.

Nice to have: Ant Design; GraphQL; ECharts or other charting libraries; design training or a portfolio; experience on a team where designers commit code; writing conventions or instructions for AI coding tools; desktop UI across Mac, Windows and Linux; dense operational tooling such as observability, security or infrastructure products.

Not required: a computer science degree, if your work shows the same rigor. Deep backend, security or infrastructure expertise, or any knowledge of our domain (fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement). We will teach that.

Your first 90 days

  1. First month: land changes safely. Ship scoped fixes in the consoles. Learn the component library, theme tokens and API layer. Start reviewing designer merge requests alongside an engineer.

  2. Second month: own review on a surface. Become the primary reviewer for designer-authored UI on one product area, and extract at least one repeated pattern into a shared component.

  3. Third month: make the next branch easier. Get the flows you own covered by tests in CI, and write down the conventions and guardrails that make designer branches need less hardening.

About BlueRock:

BlueRock is a well-funded, early stage cybersecurity company founded by experienced security minded entrepreneurs. Our mission is to change the game in cybersecurity. Attackers are exploiting in hours. The dependency tree is exploding. Developers are drowning in vulnerability debt. BlueRock changes the game, enabling organizations to shift from chasing CVEs and exploits to proactively protecting the foundations of applications and computing, so that developers can build great applications without looking over their shoulders.

title: Responsable Process et Travaux Neufs F/H/X
descriptionHtml:
Chez Symrise, le segment Goût, Nutrition & Santé s’appuie sur son expertise et sa recherche scientifique pour offrir à ses clients et partenaires des solutions uniques et durables à base d’ingrédients naturels dans les domaines du goût, de la nutrition et de la santé. Avec plus de 100 sites dans plus de 40 pays, ce segment dessert l’industrie agroalimentaire ainsi que les fabricants d’aliments pour animaux de compagnie et d’aquaculture. Il est structuré en deux divisions — Food & Beverage et Pet Food.

La division Pet Food propose des solutions produits et des services pour améliorer l’appétence et l’acceptation des aliments pour animaux, garantir leur sécurité et soutenir la santé animale. Pour étudier l’acceptation alimentaire, le comportement alimentaire et les interactions entre animaux et propriétaires, la division dispose de quatre centres experts avec environ 1 000 chiens et chats en propriété.

Suivant le principe « plus proche, mieux c’est », Symrise Pet Food, au sein du segment Goût, Nutrition & Santé, sert ses clients depuis plus de 30 sites dans le monde

Vos missions

  • Manager et accompagner une équipe de 5 personnes : projets travaux neufs, qualification de nouveaux process et services généraux (pilotage de projets, communication ascendante et descendante, déploiement du plan de formation, organisation du service)

  • Contribuer à l’élaboration du plan directeur du site en cours en collaboration étroite avec la direction du site, la direction des Opérations du groupe Symrise

  • Rédiger les cahiers des charges , spécifications, analyses fonctionnelles et les besoins attendus des projets TN et process.

  • Piloter techniquement, administrativement et budgétairement les projets et équipes travaux neufs confiés par la Direction des Opérations Usine, dans le respect des règles QHSE et des standards Groupe

  • Construire les dossiers de demande d’investissements et maitriser les budgets alloués.

  • Assurer la bonne coordination et validation techniques auprès des équipes locales et globales.

  • Conduire les revues de pilotage de projet et réunions de projet avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (production , logistique, maintenance, qualité, sécurité, environnement, ingéniérie)

  • Superviser la réalisation des travaux (process, bâtiments, utilités) en garantissant coût, qualité, délai et sécurité

  • Conduire la mise en service et la qualification opérationnelle des nouvelles installations y compris la validation des instructions rédigées

  • Suivre la performance des procédés, définir les plans d’action d’amélioration et accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans le changement

  • Garantir la conformité réglementaire et documentaire des équipements et des installations

  • Assurer le suivi des prestataires et le respect des exigences HSE

  • Déployer et faire respecter les procédures internes et les règles HQSE

Vos compétences

Issu(e) d’une formation ingénieur ou équivalent, vous disposez d’une expérience significative minimum de 7 ans en environnement industriel, impérativement dans le secteur agroalimentaire. Vous avez développé un fort Leadership et solides compétences en management d’équipe et gestion. De solides compétences en procédés industriels, idéalement sur des équipements de cuisson sous pression, de séchage, de mélange ou encore d’ensachage, ainsi qu’en maintenance des installations.

Vous maîtrisez les exigences réglementaires liées aux équipements industriels et aux ICPE, ainsi que les normes en matière de sécurité, d’environnement et d’hygiène, notamment HACCP. Vous êtes également à l’aise avec les enjeux liés à la construction de bâtiments industriels et à la gestion de projets d’investissement, incluant le pilotage de prestataires et la sécurité des sous-traitants.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous avez une bonne pratique des outils et méthodes d’amélioration continue (5S, analyse de déroulement, diagramme d’Ishikawa…) et êtes capable d’analyser et de structurer des données chiffrées pour en tirer des plans d’actions pertinents. Vous êtes à l’aise avec la rédaction de modes opératoires et de supports de formation. Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques, notamment SAP, et évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international grâce à un anglais courant.

Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre goût du terrain, votre sens de l’organisation et votre capacité à structurer, vous savez également faire preuve d’agilité et d’adaptation dans des environnements exigeants. Doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes capable de fédérer les équipes autour d’objectifs communs, avec diplomatie et efficacité. Enfin, votre curiosité et votre passion pour l’industrie et les process seront des atouts clés pour réussir sur ce poste.

Avantages

Intégrez un secteur en pleine croissance : notre entreprise évolue dans le marché dynamique du pet food, un secteur en constante expansion, porté par des tendances durables et une demande mondiale croissante. Vous rejoindrez un acteur clé d’une industrie à fort potentiel, résolument tourné vers l’avenir.

Plongez dans un environnement international stimulant : vous serez au cœur des échanges entre le site de production en France et les équipes du groupe à l’étranger. Cette dimension multiculturelle vous permettra de développer une vision globale des enjeux de sécurité industrielle et d’élargir vos compétences dans un cadre enrichissant.

Contribuez activement à un projet d’amélioration continue ambitieux : vous aurez l’opportunité de piloter des projets à fort impact, dans une logique de progrès durable et d’innovation, avec le soutien d’une direction engagée.

title: Sachbearbeiter:in Innendienst (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wenn du…

…innovative neue Wege im eCommerce gehen willst und nach dem passenden Umfeld suchst, um deine Wachstumsideen gemeinsam umzusetzen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Unsere Mission…

Sachbearbeiter:in im Innendienst (m/w/d)

für den Kundenservice und stehst unseren Kund:innen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

Bei uns erhältst du die Kombination aus ausführlicher Einarbeitung unserer E-Commerce-Fachleute, Arbeit mit einem fantastischen Produktportfolio und erfahrenen Teammitgliedern sowie deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, den du gestalten und prägen kannst.

Zusammen mit dem Team bei b-cube sorgst du dafür, dass wir ein attraktives Angebot für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zur Verfügung stellen, indem du:

  • Kundenanfragen per E-Mail und Telefon beantwortest und schnell die passenden Lösungen findest.
  • unsere regionalen und internationalen Kunden mit einer individuellen Produktberatung überzeugst.
  • die Versand- und Lieferprozesse koodinierst und eine reibungslose und termingerechte Auslieferung ermöglichst.
  • den Informationsfluss zwischen unseren Teams im Vertrieb, der Warenlogistik und dem Einkauf begleitest und die Auftragsabwicklung im Sinne unserer Kund:innen sicherstellst.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

Du musst kein Sanitär-Profi sein. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, Verantwortung übernimmst und Dinge selbstständig voranbringst. Du findest dich in folgenden Punkten wieder:

  • Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Innendienst, E-Commerce oder in der Auftragsbearbeitung
  • Du telefonierst gerne und hast keine Scheu vor dem direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen
  • Du kannst dich schriftlich sicher und freundlich ausdrücken
  • Du bist geduldig, verbindlich und bleibst auch bei schwierigen Gesprächen professionell
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert
  • Du denkst mit und packst die Dinge selbstständig an
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und digitalen Systemen
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Sanitär/Haustechnik? Ein Plus – aber kein Muss.

Benefits

Das ist bei uns üblich:

  • ausführliche Einarbeitung unserer E-Commerce-Fachleute
  • Sparring zu Branchenthemen mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern
  • eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, den du gestalten und prägen kannst
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Duz-Kultur und ein freundliches Arbeitsumfeld
  • Hybrides Arbeiten
  • 30 Tage Urlaub

About the Role

We're looking for a highly driven SDR to join our team. You’ll be at the heart of our growth engine - managing the beginning of our sales cycle, directly driving our business and revenue growth by bringing in new customers.

In this role, you’ll blend your people and communication skills with passion to make hospitality businesses more smooth in their operations. You will act as the first point of contact for the customer, working collaboratively with internal departments to ensure we are not just winning business, but building long-term value and market share.

What You’ll Do

  • Own top of the funnel activity for a dedicated region.

  • Hit conversion targets across the stages of the funnel that are in your responsibility.

  • Communicate our value and mission to our prospective partners, build trusted relationships with the hospitality network in the region.

  • Do market research and competition analysis to identify opportunities within your region.

  • Collaborate with Ops, Product, and Leadership to remove bottlenecks and improve scaling.

  • Ensure smooth handoff to Success following close to drive activation and ongoing performance.

  • Maintain high CRM hygiene to enable the best handover to the sales and success team.

What You’ll Need

  • 0-1 years of experience in Sales, Sales Operations or Customer-facing roles ideally within SaaS/ Tech/ Hospitality or Startup space.

  • Passion for the hospitality industry and customer-facing activities is a strong plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) is a strong plus.

  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves and “Leave your ego at the door” mentality

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in fast-moving environments, love building from scratch, and bias toward action.

  • The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and Dutch

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Security engineer, detection and response (UK)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Join WRITER's security team as a staff detection and response engineer and help protect the AI infrastructure that's transforming how the world works. You'll build sophisticated detection systems that identify attacks targeting our AI platform, training data, and model deployments while creating automated response capabilities that scale with our explosive growth. This isn't just traditional security work – you're defending cutting-edge AI/AGI systems against adversaries who are evolving their tactics as fast as AI itself advances.

This role combines hands-on security engineering with strategic thinking to stay ahead of novel threats that don't exist in textbooks yet. You'll be the operational arm of our security function, translating threat intelligence into real-time detections, coordinating incident response across multiple teams, and hunting for sophisticated attacks across GPU clusters and distributed training environments. If you're excited by the challenge of securing systems that are fundamentally different from anything you've protected before, this is your opportunity to define what AI security engineering looks like at scale.

You'll work closely with our AI Security research team, Cloud Infrastructure, Software Security Engineering, and AI researchers to build a defense-in-depth strategy that protects one of the most valuable AI platforms in the industry. The threats are real, the stakes are high, and the problems are intellectually fascinating.

This role can be based inSan reporting to our head of security operations.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

  • Design and implement detection strategies that identify AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, data poisoning, adversarial examples, and unauthorized access to training datasets or model weights across our distributed infrastructure

  • Build automated response playbooks and orchestration workflows that contain threats without human intervention, creating self-healing security systems that reduce mean time to response from hours to minutes while automatically remediating compromised inference endpoints

  • Lead security incident response coordination across all teams (Cloud, AppSec, Enterprise, AI Security) when AI infrastructure or models are compromised, conducting forensic investigations on training pipeline attacks and model manipulation attempts while drafting clear incident communications for engineering and executive leadership

  • Hunt proactively for sophisticated threats across GPU clusters and training infrastructure by analyzing model outputs for signs of compromise, reproducing AI-specific vulnerabilities from security research, and identifying visibility gaps in distributed training environments before adversaries exploit them

  • Build detection-as-code frameworks with version control and automated deployment, onboard telemetry from AI training infrastructure and inference endpoints, and create dashboards that track model security metrics, GPU utilization patterns, and access to sensitive research data

  • Collaborate cross-functionally as the operational security partner for all teams – translating AI Security's threat research into production detections, monitoring Cloud Infrastructure's GPU clusters for threats, detecting customer-impacting incidents for Software Security Engineering, and enabling responsible AI development through security guardrails

  • Maintain 24/7 on-call rotation for critical AI security incidents, responding to real-time threats targeting our platform while continuously improving detection coverage and automation capabilities as our AI systems evolve

⭐️ What you need

  • 3-5+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response with a proven track record of identifying and stopping sophisticated attacks in production environments, plus 3+ years specifically securing AI/ML infrastructure, high-performance computing environments, or other distributed systems at scale

  • Strong programming skills in Python, KQL, SPL, or similar languages that allow you to build custom detection logic, automate response workflows, and create tools that operationalize security at scale across cloud-native and distributed computing environments

  • Experience with SIEM platforms, detection technologies, and forensic investigation techniques with demonstrated ability to build detection for novel attack techniques that don't have established patterns yet and to conduct forensics in complex distributed environments

  • Self-directed execution mindset with a track record of securing high-value intellectual property, automating incident response in complex environments, and identifying critical security gaps through proactive threat hunting before they become incidents

  • Deep alignment with WRITER's values – you naturally Connect across security, infrastructure, and AI research teams to build comprehensive defenses, you Challenge assumptions about what's possible in AI security engineering, and you Own the protection of our AI platform with unwavering accountability and a commitment to staying ahead of evolving threats

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

  • Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners.

  • Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment.

The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

Our partners trust us with their most valuable secrets: unpublished targets, novel molecules and years of proprietary assay data. Your job is to make sure that trust is well placed, everywhere our platform runs: our own cloud, dedicated single-tenant environments, and partners' own AWS and Google Cloud accounts.

You will be a founding engineer on our security team, part of the Platform team in Core Engineering, shaping the security program with our CTO, who leads it today. You will work with every engineering team at Boltz, and you will sit across the table from the security leaders of the world's largest pharma companies.

We want security to be the reason a partner says yes faster, not the reason a deal stalls. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who would rather fix a control in code than write a document about it, and who can explain risk clearly to a pharma CISO.

What you'll do

  • Make secure the default: build guardrails into our Terraform, Kubernetes and CI/CD so every new cluster, environment and partner deployment inherits the right boundaries from day one.

  • Protect what matters most: keep partner data isolated across tenants and deployments, protect our model weights, and make sure the agents acting on scientists' behalf can only do what they should.

  • Make the secure path the easy path: identity, secrets, service-to-service authentication and supply-chain controls that engineers actually want to use.

  • See and stop threats: logging, detection and incident response across AWS and GCP, with exercises that keep us sharp.

  • Find weaknesses first: threat-model new features before they ship, run penetration tests, and attack our own agents and APIs before anyone else does.

  • Turn trust into an advantage: lead security reviews with partners' security teams, translate their requirements into engineering work early, and run our SOC 2 Type II program and the frameworks partners ask for next (e.g. ISO 27001) with evidence generated by our systems, not by screenshots.

  • Secure the company: identity, device management, access reviews and security awareness for a small, highly technical team.

This role is not a compliance-only (GRC) or SOC analyst role. Most of your time goes into engineering; compliance should be a by-product of controls that actually work.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of security engineering experience in cloud-native SaaS or infrastructure companies.

  • Deep, hands-on cloud security experience on AWS or Google Cloud: IAM and multi-account or multi-project organizations, network security, encryption and key management, audit logging and threat detection.

  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and enough hands-on engineering to ship security improvements yourself.

  • Application security experience: threat modeling, secure code review, authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth/OIDC, MFA), web and API vulnerabilities.

  • Experience owning a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 program through an external audit, or building the controls one depends on.

  • Practical incident response experience.

  • Low ego, high ownership, and pragmatic trade-offs between risk and speed; clear with engineers, leadership and partners' security teams alike.

Preferred Requirements

  • Kubernetes and container security (network policy, admission control, workload identity, image signing).

  • Security for ML or LLM systems: agent tool access, prompt injection, model and training-data protection.

  • Experience as an early or founding security hire at a startup.

  • Securing deployments in customer-controlled, multi-cloud or regulated environments.

  • Exposure to life-sciences or pharma security and data-protection expectations (e.g. GDPR).

  • Offensive security or penetration testing background.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Shape the security program that lets the world's leading pharma companies trust frontier AI with their discovery programs.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Security design and threat-modeling interview

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

The AI Transformation team

AI Transformation is a small, focused squad that is driving Multiverse’s next wave of growth. Our mandate is to rebuild how the company actually works, function by function, and to establish the practices that make Multiverse an AI-first company from the core out.

But our work doesn’t stop there. We are building a product that we will take to market to truly be a transformation partner to our customers. Joining this team means shaping the future of Multiverse, of our customers, and of the wider workforce as we navigate the new world of work.

The team is high velocity, inherently cross-functional and broad in scope. We work alongside colleagues whose work we are reimagining, and closely with the wider engineering org building Multiverse's current customer-facing product. The structure is flat and fast, with egos left at the door, bias to action and fun at our core.

What your day-to-day will look like

Every day will be different, but you can expect it to include:

Own and deliver end-to-end AI systems: agents and the platforms they depend on. You identify a user problem, break it down and build the AI system that solves it, in close partnership with the teams who will adopt it

Design context and retrieval strategies: the retrieval pipelines, conversation memory, summarisation strategies, chunking logic and RBAC that make context useful and permission-aware

Build evaluation frameworks. You build automated eval pipelines and human-in-the-loop review processes that tell the team whether its AI systems are doing what they should.

Design tool integrations. Agents are only as capable as the systems and context they can reach. You design and build the tool layer: MCPs, APIs, data contracts, and the error handling that makes tool use reliable.

Influence technical direction. You have opinions about how things should be built, and you back them up with evidence. You contribute to architectural decisions, push back when the team is heading in the wrong direction, and propose better approaches.

What We Are Looking For

  • Production AI Agent Engineering: You have shipped AI systems that serve real users at scale. You understand the engineering challenges that make agent systems different from conventional software, including context management, model selection and routing, cost engineering, tool use and agent augmentation, and evaluation

  • Product mindset: Your natural instinct is to identify the real user pain, understand their requirements and build pragmatic, high-impact solutions. You test, learn and iterate fast, and are comfortable executing under high ambiguity

  • Full-Stack Delivery: You work across the stack: LLM integration, backend services, data pipelines, and enough frontend to ship end to end

  • Communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business colleagues. You proactively engage the people around your work, and bring them along with you on the journey

  • Fluent in AI-assisted development and can mentor others to do it well

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. descriptionHtml:

Bei Mayflower arbeiten wir in agilen Teams und legen großen Wert darauf, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Dazu bieten wir spannende Use Cases, großen Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, echten Einfluss beim Kunden zu nehmen.

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich „Generative AI" aus und suchen dich, um gemeinsam agentische AI-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden echte Probleme lösen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Mit Begeisterung nutzt du moderne agentische Entwicklungsmethoden, entwickelst mit deinem Team Best Practices und förderst kontinuierlich den Wissenstransfer zu moderne AI-Architekturen, Model Optimization und Enterprise-AI-Integration.
  • Du verfolgst relevante Trends und bringst Inhalte für Whitepaper, Landing Pages, Workshop-Konzepte und AI-Produkte ein, um Kunden für uns zu begeistern.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit LLMs und Agentic-RAG-Implementierungen sowie mit AI-Agent-Frameworks – ob im Python-Umfeld (LangGraph, Deepagents), im TypeScript-Bereich (Eve, Flue, Mastra) oder im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Erfahrung mit Vector Databases und MLOps ist von Vorteil.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.

  • Sinnhafte Projekte: Entwickle Software, die relevante Kundenprobleme löst und Usern das Leben leichter macht.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.

descriptionHtml:

If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Analyst, Stock Operations to support the day-to-day administration and operation of Nscale's global equity programs.

This is an individual contributor role within the People team, as part of the Reward function, reporting directly to the Director, Equity Operations. You'll work closely with Reward, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Tax, HR Operations, People Partners, and external vendors to ensure equity programs are administered accurately, efficiently, and in line with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

This role is important to delivering operational excellence across Nscale's equity programs while helping create a consistent, high-quality employee experience throughout the equity lifecycle. You'll bring a strong operational mindset to a fast-paced, high-growth environment where accuracy, partnership, and continuous improvement matter.

What you'll be doing

  • Administer day-to-day equity plan activities, including grants, vesting events, exercises, releases, transfers, and terminations.

  • Process equity transactions accurately in accordance with plan rules, internal controls, and established service levels.
  • Maintain employee equity records and help ensure data integrity across equity, HRIS, payroll, and finance systems.
  • Partner with stock plan vendors and administrators to resolve operational issues and support the smooth execution of equity events.

Reporting & Analysis

Employee Support & Communications

Compliance & Controls

  • Support the preparation of data required for board reporting and annual filings.

Process Improvement & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and improve equity administration processes.
  • Support Workday, equity platform, and broader systems enhancement projects.
  • Assist with the implementation and testing of new processes, controls, and technologies.
  • Work closely with the Equity Operations leader and cross-functional stakeholders to provide accurate, timely information that supports decision-making.

KPIs

  • Accuracy of equity transaction processing
  • Timeliness of recurring and ad hoc equity reporting
  • Data integrity across equity, HRIS, payroll, and finance systems
  • Resolution of employee and vendor operational enquiries

About You

  • Experience in stock plan administration, equity compensation, share plan operations, or a related field, either in-house or consulting.
  • Experience administering employee equity plans in a multinational or publicly traded company environment.
  • Understanding of stock options, RSUs, RSAs, Performance Awards, vesting schedules, exercises, and employee share plans.
  • Experience preparing operational reports and analysing equity data.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large datasets.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including drafting employee-facing communications.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀

Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨

Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.

Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation.  We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.  

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit our website.

Position Overview

Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, assisting Vice Presidents and other senior staff by providing conceptual and practical input to competition case work as required. The role brings with it the possibility of working on some of the largest and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in the shaping of the cases.

Desired Qualifications

  • First degree in economics and a PhD/DPhil in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialism with large data sets (empirical PhDs) or Industrial Organisation and/or statistics/econometrics), plus up to 3 years of relevant work experience.
    • Non-PhD applicants should have strong academic achievement in a Master's program, plus 5-7 years' relevant work experience;
  • Professional work experience in consulting, business, or with a competition authority strongly preferred;
  • Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities, competition policy and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills.

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;
  • Transcripts (optional) - from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Business Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Transportbedrijven staan voor grote veranderingen. Digitalisering, SaaS, data, integraties, automatisering en AI bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden. Maar technologie alleen lost niets op. Het begint met begrijpen hoe een klant werkt, waar processen vastlopen, welke verandering nodig is en waar werkelijk waarde kan worden toegevoegd.

Daarom zoeken wij een Senior Business Consultant Transport voor onze locatie in Hoogeveen. Iemand die niet begint met onze software, maar met de business van de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Jij doorgrondt logistieke processen, ziet kansen en krijgt organisaties in beweging.

Hoe kunnen transportorganisaties slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendiger werken? Als Senior Business Consultant Transport help jij onze klanten om die stap te zetten. Je bent een strategische gesprekspartner voor planners, key-users, IT, operations en management. Je begrijpt hun processen en uitdagingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen en slimme oplossingen.

Je kijkt verder dan de technologie alleen. Je onderzoekt wat een organisatie écht nodig heeft en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen niet alleen worden bedacht en geïmplementeerd, maar ook daadwerkelijk worden omarmd en toegepast.

Welke werkzaamheden kan je verder verwachten?

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van transport- en logistieke processen.

  • Leiden van workshops en adviseren van klanten over procesverbetering en digitalisering.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete requirements en oplossingsrichtingen.

  • Adviseren over SaaS, integraties, data, automatisering en AI.

  • Begeleiden van verandertrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en adoptie.

  • Creëren van draagvlak en meenemen van stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen en bijdragen aan demo's, offertes en businesscases.

  • Vertalen van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar nieuwe toepassingen, samen met Product Owners en de business.

  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega-consultants.

Meer dan alleen consultancy

We zoeken geen consultant die zich uitsluitend richt op software of configuraties. We zoeken iemand die de vraag achter de vraag ontdekt, processen durft uit te dagen en klanten helpt écht stappen vooruit te zetten.

Je combineert inhoudelijke expertise met commercieel inzicht. Doordat je dicht bij de klant staat, herken je kansen voor aanvullende oplossingen en dienstverlening. Je weet deze te vertalen naar concrete meerwaarde voor de klant en onze organisatie.

Technologie én mensen in beweging brengen

Je hebt affiniteit met technologie en volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van SaaS, API's, data, automatisering en AI. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn, maar weet technologische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar praktische toepassingen.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat succesvolle verandering begint bij mensen. Je herkent verschillende belangen, maakt weerstand bespreekbaar en weet organisaties mee te nemen in een nieuwe manier van werken. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de go-live: het gaat om daadwerkelijk gebruik en blijvend resultaat.

Jij adviseert niet alleen hoe het beter kan, maar zorgt ervoor dat het ook écht beter wordt.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als senior business consultant rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.200,- en €5.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,25 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

  • hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • ruime ervaring als business consultant, businessanalist, solution consultant of in een vergelijkbare rol;

  • aantoonbare affiniteit met of ervaring in transport en logistiek;

  • ervaring met verandermanagement, stakeholdermanagement en gebruikersadoptie;

  • het vermogen om zelfstandig bedrijfsprocessen te analyseren en te verbeteren;

  • de senioriteit om gemakkelijk te schakelen tussen operatie, IT, management en directie;

  • ervaring met workshops, interviews, analyses en presentaties;

  • het vermogen om weerstand te herkennen en om te zetten in betrokkenheid;

  • commerciële nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om kansen om te zetten naar een concreet vervolg;

  • interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en hun praktische toepassing;

  • het vermogen om complexe onderwerpen eenvoudig en overtuigend uit te leggen;

  • de drive om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en collega’s inhoudelijk sterker te maken.

Kennis van onze producten is mooi meegenomen, maar niet doorslaggevend. Productkennis kunnen we je leren. Analytisch vermogen, nieuwsgierigheid, veranderkracht en het vermogen om een klant echt verder te helpen vinden we belangrijker.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter Kimberley Vermeulen via +31 6 1072 4584 of via
Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 300 collega’s van Centric Retail & Logistiek. Als partner van bedrijven binnen Retail, Logistiek, Transport, Bouw en Financiële instellingen zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat magazijnen goed gevuld blijven, supermarkten en winkels bevoorraad worden en honderdduizenden klanten hun dagelijkse boodschappen en andere aankopen naadloos kunnen afrekenen. Maar ook dat vrachtwagens zo optimaal mogelijk beladen en geoptimaliseerde routes rijden, bouwbedrijven inzicht hebben in hun projectplanning en resources en dat financiële instellingen snel kredietrisico’s kunnen inschatten met onze risk solutions. Kortom, een rol binnen Centric Retail & Logistiek geeft je de mogelijkheid om een concrete bijdrage te leveren aan sectoren die impact hebben en maken op de maatschappij!

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

title: Senior Business Development Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the role

As a Senior Business Development Lead at SkyNRG, you’ll build and grow partnerships with large corporate customers looking to address the emissions associated with their business travel and air freight.

You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results.

  • Share customer and market insights to help continuously improve our commercial approach and propositions.

  • Management of industry initiatives and client-facing campaigns.

  • Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience.

 

Your profile

We're looking for someone who is commercially sharp, curious by nature, and motivated by helping organisations make meaningful progress towards their sustainability goals.

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of experience in a consultative B2B business development, sales, or commercial role, preferably within SAF, energy, carbon, or similarly complex or emerging markets.

  • A proven track record of developing new business and converting strategic opportunities into commercial partnerships.

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Experience leading complex commercial discussions and contract negotiations involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and data-driven business development processes.

  • The ability and motivation to quickly build expertise in SAF, SAF certificates, and the evolving regulatory landscape.

  • A continuous improvement mindset, and willingness to act as an ambassador for SkyNRG and its values: Driven, Genuine, Change-maker

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in SAF, aviation, carbon markets or related sectors.

  • Experience working in a scale-up or fast-growing business.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

  • A relevant professional network that can help open doors and create opportunities.

 

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

 

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

 

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

 

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.
