title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketing
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate is a self-starter and problem-solver, skilled at leveraging technology and data to deliver top-tier analytics solutions. They thrive on addressing complex business challenges and are consistently effective in making high-judgment decisions at a rapid pace, even in the face of ambiguity and uncharted scenarios. Additionally, the ideal candidate is energized by a work environment where strategy, innovation, and decision-making are intentionally distributed, where transparency, agility, and data-driven insights are highly valued, and where colleagues at all levels hold each other to exceptionally high standards to serve Quince customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with the US team to understand what exists that we need to replicate and the gaps that we need to build upon
  • Develop and maintain automated reports to track Marketing KPIs:
    • New/Returning Customers, LTV/CAC, Total vs. inc. ROAS
    • Performance Marketing Channel: Paid Social, SEM, App, Affiliates etc.
    • CRM: Customer cohort, Database health + Lifecycle stages
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to identify channel inefficiencies, scaling opportunities, areas for improving MER / Total ROAS.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Performance team to deliver experimentation and incrementality studies: Geo-Lift tests, Channel Incrementality, Brand lift, MMM validation. 
  • Partner with product, engineering and CRM to deliver:
    • A data driven customer lifecycle programme including key drivers of high-value customers 
    • A/B and multivariate tests across lifecycle touchpoints that optimize revenue per visit, and Incremental LTV / Revenue
    • A multi-category approach to cross selling, identifying triggers and next best actions based on customer behaviour
  • Implement data quality, governance (inc. GDPR) and AI usage best practices in collaboration with the US. 
  • Be an integral part of the international team and contribute to their growth.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or similar). Master’s degree is a plus. 
  • 7+ years in a data analytics/product analytics role, ideally with a focus on supply chain within an e-commerce or technology company.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BIm Mixpanel).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
  • Ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights, with a focus on detail, accuracy, and clarity.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Based in Berlin / London with the ability to come into the Berlin / London office 4 days per week

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in running Geo-lift tests across Europe
  • Previous e-commerce / multi-category experience
  • Strong Performance marketing (attribution) + CRM measurement background
  • Able to translate data analysis into action through storytelling and visualization
  • Understanding of core marketing metrics and how they interact to deliver profitable growth: LTV/CAC, ROAS, MER

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

The proxy handles all client connections and transfers every byte of query traffic, serving every data protocol: Postgres, HTTP, WebSockets, and Data API. We route and manage large volumes of concurrent connections, solving load balancing, authentication, and data access at high throughput. We focus on performance, observability, and reliability to ensure the data path is fast and resilient.

Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Team

Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.

We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.

You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.

You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.

Working alongside engineers responsible for the shared runtime and platform services, you will turn feedback from early users into better interfaces, defaults, tests and guidance. You will identify reusable patterns across integrations, shape shared platform capabilities, review designs and mentor colleagues. You will use coding agents and automation to accelerate development, applying the review, testing and domain judgement needed to ensure the resulting software behaves as intended.

Qualifications:

  • Strong software engineering skills, demonstrated through dependable software or developer tools used by other people.
  • Applied depth in at least one relevant area, such as robotics simulation, autonomous-vehicle evaluation, reinforcement learning, synthetic-data generation or engineering simulation.
  • Experience making specialist or research software usable beyond its original author, including configuration, testing, documentation and diagnosis.
  • Sound judgement about experimental assumptions, evaluation criteria, reproducibility and the conclusions a result supports.
  • Familiarity with containerised execution and experience tracing problems across application and infrastructure boundaries.
  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and domains, working closely with specialists and recognising when their expertise is needed.
  • Evidence of improving shared tools or engineering practices across multiple projects, with clear reasoning about what should be common and what should remain application-specific.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience developing software in Python, Go or C++.
  • Familiarity with simulation and machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience profiling GPU workloads and identifying performance or resource bottlenecks.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or workflow orchestration.

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You enjoy turning specialist Physical AI software into dependable tools that other researchers and engineers can use independently.
  • You care about making experiments understandable and reproducible, with clear evidence of what their results do and do not establish.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with curiosity about unfamiliar domains, and enjoy helping colleagues build reusable, high-quality systems.

We welcome relevant experience from industry, research engineering and academia. We are interested in what you have built, how others use it and the judgement you brought to making it work.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is £116,000 to £155,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby!

Het finance team
Het zeskoppige finance team, onder leiding van Martijn, draagt met elkaar zorg voor alle financiële processen binnen de organisatie. Zoals je je wellicht kunt voorstellen is de event/travelbranche een dynamisch speelveld waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is. Aan het finance team de taak om in samenwerking met de rest van de organisatie te zorgen voor kloppende cijfers waarop gestuurd kan worden.

Finance & Control stage
Gedurende je stage zal je compleet onderdeel zijn van het team en zorgen we voor een gevarieerd takenpakket. Je eerste weken staan in het teken van kennismaken met onze processen en werkwijzes. Daarna zul je aan de slag gaan met je eigen takenpakket. Hierbij kun je denken aan:

  • Maken van periodieke en ad hoc rapportages;

  • Meewerken aan financiële maand- en jaarafsluitingen;

  • Uitvoeren van checks en controles op o.a juistheid en volledigheid van financiële data en processen;

  • Maken van resultaatboekingen op events en het analyseren daarvan.

Naast het op doen van waardevolle ervaring in de organisatie gaan we graag met je in gesprek over grote en uitdagende projecten die P1 en jou verder helpt in de ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld het zelf opzetten van managementrapportages.


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt momenteel een financiële studie in de richting van Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfsadministratie, Finance & Control o.i.d. en bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage per januari/februari 2027.

  • Je bent pro-actief, wil zoveel mogelijk leren en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal.

  • Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook!

Waar kom je terecht?

We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 80 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die van start gaat.

Dit krijg jij ervoor terug!

Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. Elke stagiair die wij hebben gehad kijkt terug op een onvergetelijke tijd.

''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!''

Enthousiast geworden? Goed om te horen! Laat snel van je horen via de solliciteerknop door je CV en een motivatie te sturen. Is deze stage niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Check dan zeker ook nog even de andere stagevacatures.

title: Stage: Innovative Strategic Business Design
descriptionHtml:
Jouw ideeën. Echte uitdagingen. Zichtbare impact. Welkom bij Lab271.

Ben jij een gedreven (master) student Industrial Design Engineering en op zoek naar een hands-on stage in strategic business design en innovatie, waarbij je écht het verschil kunt maken? Dan is deze kans bij Schuberg Philis iets voor jou! Bij ons werk je niet alleen aan projecten voor toonaangevende klanten zoals PostNL, NS en Heineken, maar draag je ook bij aan het innovatieve kloppend hart van onze organisatie: Lab271. 

Over Schuberg Philis
Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we trots op wat we doen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en beheren van cruciale computersystemen voor grote bedrijven, waaronder Geldmaat, ING en de Haven van Rotterdam. Als stagiair maak je deel uit van ons innovatieteam Lab271 en krijg je de kans om jouw creativiteit en vaardigheden in te zetten om echte problemen op te lossen. 

Over Lab271
Lab271 is het innovatielab waar toekomstgerichte oplossingen worden ontwikkeld voor uitdagende vraagstukken. Hier draait alles om experimenteren en het toepassen van opkomende technologieën om echte problemen aan te pakken. Je zult werken aan onderzoek, conceptontwerp, prototyping, business modelling, visualisaties en workshops voor diverse klanten. Ben je benieuwd naar wat één van je voorgangers heeft gedaan? Bekijk dan hier het verslag! 

Wat ga je doen

  • Onderzoek en analyse van complexe klantvragen.
  • Vertalen van businessproblemen naar creatieve oplossingen.
  • Conceptontwerp en prototyping van innovatieve producten en diensten.
  • Faciliteren van workshops en events.
  • Bijdragen aan de groei en innovatie van Schuberg Philis.   

Wie wij zoeken

  • Een enthousiaste en proactieve student, bij voorkeur volg je de Master Industrial Design.
  • Affiniteit met technologie, innovatie, design en digital.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een “can do”-mentaliteit.
  • Creatief denkvermogen en probleemoplossend vermogen.
  • Beschikbaarheid voor minimaal 5 maanden fulltime (startdatum in overleg, bij voorkeur september of februari). 

Wat wij bieden

  • Een creatieve, inspirerende en dynamische werkomgeving.
  • Awesome customers. Groot of klein, binnen Lab271 krijg je de kans om met allemaal te kunnen werken.
  • Je bent onderdeel van een multidisciplinair team met innovators en onconventionele denkers, die je graag helpen om te ontwikkelen.  
  • Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en creativiteit.
  • Eens per kwartaal een innovatietrip en andere uitjes.  
  • Lekker en gezond ontbijt, lunch en avondeten.
  • Kantoren in Schiphol-Rijk en het centrum van Rotterdam.
  • Een stagevergoeding.
  • Macbook Pro & een iPhone tot je beschikking tijdens de stage.  

Interesse?
Bij Schuberg Philis krijg je de kans om vanaf dag één impact te maken. Van het vertalen van een businessprobleem naar een eerste prototype, wij geloven in jouw potentieel om échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Ben jij klaar om jouw talenten te laten zien en deel uit te maken van ons innovatieteam Lab271? 

Upload je portfolio, indien je die hebt, en specificeer in je aanmelding je gewenste startmaand en hoe lang je stage wilt lopen. 

Neem nu contact met ons op en ontdek de mogelijkheden voor jouw stage bij Schuberg Philis!

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. 

It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement (6 mois) - F/H - Nantes
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vos missions :

Vous serez support au pilotage et à l'animation d'études d'impacts sur l'environnement de parcs éoliens et centrales solaires comprenant notamment le volet naturel, le volet paysager et des études spécifiques.

Vous serez en lien avec l'équipe projet, les autorités et les spécialistes pour identifier et traiter l'ensemble des risques environnementaux des projets.

Vous participerez à la concertation de tous les acteurs permettant de réaliser la conception de projets la plus adaptée au territoire.

Vous proposerez des axes d'amélioration sur les mesures E-R-C-A (Eviter, Réduire, Compenser, Accompagner) des projets éoliens et solaires.

En particulier les axes d'amélioration suivants ont été identifiés :

  • Amélioration du bilan carbone des projets (outils, méthodologies) et proposition de mesures de réduction de l’impact carbone des projets.
  • Amélioration de la gestion des risques dans les projets solaires développés en SIS (sites et sols pollués).
  • Amélioration de la synergie entre projets solaires et stockage batterie-BESS (projets d’hybridation).

Vous participerez au dépôt des dossiers de demande de permis de construire et à leurs instructions (Commission CDPENAF, Enquête Publique, Réponse avis MRAe,...).

Vous aurez l'occasion de suivre la mise en place concrète de mesures environnementales en phase chantier/construction sur une centrale solaire.

HSE :

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement 
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques

Qualité :

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité 
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité 
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil :

  • Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable
  • Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel.

Localisation et déplacements

Durée : 6 mois

Localisation : Nantes - déplacements ponctuels en Bretagne / Pays de la Loire / Centre Val de Loire

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ?

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées 
  • Un management de proximité 
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante 
  • Une entreprise en constant développement 
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences 

Nos avantages sociaux

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires
  • Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité 
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société) 
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives.

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

title: Stagiair HBO Logistiek/ Supply chain
descriptionHtml:
STAGIAIR HBO LOGISTIEK / SUPPLY CHAIN
32-40 uur

Wil jij jouw analytische talent inzetten voor logistieke vraagstukken met directe impact? Bij BERG hebben we meerdere stageplekken binnen Logistiek & Supply Chain. Je werkt aan een concrete opdracht waarmee je onze logistieke processen verder professionaliseert en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw eigen ideeën en oplossingen te ontwikkelen.

Of je nu enthousiast wordt van logistieke optimalisatie en containerbelading of juist van transportdata, benchmarking en dashboards: bij BERG is er ruimte voor jouw talent.

Create your future
Als stagiair(e) Logistiek & Supply Chain werk je bij BERG aan een logistiek vraagstuk met directe impact op onze internationale supply chain. We hebben meerdere stageplekken, waarbij je afhankelijk van jouw interesse aan de slag gaat met één van onze twee opdrachten.

Interesse in logistieke optimalisatie? Dan ontwikkel je een Container Load & Capacity Optimizer. Je onderzoekt hoe we onze containerruimte beter kunnen benutten en ontwikkelt op basis van onder andere SKU’s, afmetingen, gewichten en laadrestricties een praktische tool die de optimale belading en benodigde capaciteit berekent.

Ligt jouw interesse meer bij transport, data en dashboards? Dan ontwikkel je een Transport Benchmark & Selectie Dashboard. Je analyseert offertes van pakket- en palletvervoerders en maakt tarieven, toeslagen, gewichtsklassen, landen en serviceniveaus inzichtelijk. Met scenarioanalyses en een dashboard help je BERG om transporteurs beter te vergelijken en besparingsmogelijkheden te ontdekken.

Bij beide opdrachten werk je met data, Excel en mogelijk AI en is er volop ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën. Je werkt samen met logistieke collega’s en zorgt ervoor dat jouw oplossing niet alleen goed werkt, maar ook daadwerkelijk binnen BERG gebruikt kan worden.

100% you
Voor beide stageopdrachten zoeken we studenten die analytisch sterk zijn en graag een complex logistiek vraagstuk vertalen naar een praktische oplossing.

• Je volgt een hbo-opleiding in Logistiek, Supply Chain Management, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
• Je hebt sterk analytisch en wiskundig inzicht.
• Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd, kritisch en zelfstandig.
• Je vindt het leuk om data te analyseren en hiermee tot concrete oplossingen te komen.
• Je hebt affiniteit met Excel, data-analyse, dashboards en/of AI-toepassingen.
• Je bent praktisch en bedrijfsmatig ingesteld en betrekt gebruikers actief bij jouw oplossing.

What’s in it for you?
Je krijgt de kans om mee te werken aan concrete logistieke vraagstukken binnen een internationaal merk en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die écht gebruikt worden binnen BERG. Je draait mee met ervaren logistieke collega’s en krijgt zo de kans om veel te leren over supply chain, transport, data en optimalisatie.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om te experimenteren, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en écht impact te maken op onze logistieke processen.

Tot slot nog:
Stagevergoeding €450,- per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur)
Gratis fruit en elke dag verse lunch in onze kantine tegen een kleine vergoeding
Tafelvoetballen en/of springen in onze springtuin tijdens de pauzes
Met grote regelmaat leuke teamactiviteiten en competities

descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;
  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;
  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;
  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;
  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;
  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;
  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;
  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;
  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;
  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels
  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;
  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;
  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 5 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;
  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;
  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;
  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;
  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;
  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;
  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;
  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;
  • Poste exercé en 100 % télétravail ;
  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;
  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;
  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;
  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

title: Systems Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Mission

You will be responsible for integrating, configuring and testing Alta Ares systems, ensuring they are technically ready for demonstrations, trials and operational deployments.

Working closely with our international Product & Engineering teams and UK Field Operations, you will act as a key technical point of contact, troubleshooting issues and translating operational requirements into practical technical solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Integrate and configure hardware and software components across Alta Ares' product portfolio.

  • Support system testing, validation, field trials and customer demonstrations.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software and connectivity issues.

  • Support the technical preparation and execution of UK and international deployments.

  • Work closely with Product & Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve system performance.

  • Translate operational requirements into technical integration needs.

  • Maintain technical documentation, configuration records and integration procedures.

  • Contribute to building Alta Ares' local technical capabilities in the UK.


Candidate Profile

  • 3+ years of experience in system integration, systems engineering or a related technical role.

  • Experience integrating complex hardware and software systems.

  • Strong knowledge and practical experience of the SAPIENT protocol

  • Familiarity with networking, APIs or embedded systems.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Understanding of system architectures, interfaces and communication protocols.

  • Comfortable working hands-on with equipment in both workshop and field environments.

  • Able to work autonomously and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to travel internationally.

Nice to Have

  • Defense, aerospace, robotics or autonomous systems experience.

  • Knowledge of UAS, UAV, ISR or C-UAS technologies.

  • Experience with sensors, EO/IR payloads, RF communications and datalinks.

  • Experience supporting military demonstrations, trials or operational deployments.

title: Teamlead Electrical Engineering (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme (BESS)
descriptionHtml:
Die AXSOL GmbH entwickelt innovative Batteriespeichersysteme für unterschiedlichste Anwen­dungen. Mit unseren Energy Container Solutions kombinieren wir stationäre Batteriespeicher in modularen Energiecontainern mit unserem hauseigenen Energiemanagementsystem AXOS. So ermöglichen wir eine effiziente Integration erneuerbarer Energien, erhöhen die Versorgungs­sicher­heit, senken Kosten und schaffen verlässliche Planungsgrundlagen. Als erfahrener Projektpartner beglei­ten wir unsere Kunden von der Auslegung über die Planung bis hin zur Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Batteriespeicherlösungen.

Mission

Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung unseres Electrical-Engineering-Teams und stellst sicher, dass unsere Batteriespeichersysteme technisch durchdacht, qualitativ hochwertig und effizient umgesetzt werden. Als erfahrene technische Persönlichkeit gibst du deinem Team Orientierung, begeisterst für gemeinsame Ziele und förderst eine offene, konstruktive Zusammenarbeit.

Dein Einstiegsschwerpunkt liegt aufgrund der hohen technischen Anforderungen zunächst auf der fachlichen Führung. Perspektivisch übernimmst du auch die disziplinarische Verantwortung für dein Team. Dafür bringst du nicht unbedingt langjährige Führungserfahrung mit, sondern vor allem die Persönlichkeit, Motivation und das Potenzial, Menschen zu führen, zu entwickeln und gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Director Operations sowie unseren Teams aus Software & Automation, Projektmanagement, Service und Vertrieb zusammen und gestaltest die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme und unserer Engineering-Roadmap maßgeblich mit.

  • Du gibst fachliche Orientierung, setzt technische Leitplanken und unterstützt dein Team bei komplexen Fragestellungen und Entscheidungen.

  • Du begeisterst dein Team für gemeinsame Ziele, förderst Eigenverantwortung, Zusammenarbeit und eine offene Feedback- und Fehlerkultur.

  • Du förderst den Wissenstransfer und die fachliche Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden und wächst schrittweise in die disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung hinein.

Technische Verantwortung und Projektumsetzung

  • Du verantwortest die elektrotechnische Qualität unserer Batteriespeichersysteme und stellst eine konsistente technische Auslegung über unsere Projekte hinweg sicher.

  • Du koordinierst technische Anforderungen und Schnittstellen zwischen Batteriesystemen, Wechselrichtern, Mittelspannung, elektrischer Infrastruktur, Netzanschluss und Anlagenregelung.

  • Du etablierst geeignete technische Reviews und Freigabeprozesse und stellst sicher, dass kritische Engineering-Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar dokumentiert werden.

  • Du stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Normen, Netzanschlussrichtlinien sowie interner Qualitäts- und Engineering-Standards sicher.

  • Du unterstützt bei technischen Risikoanalysen, Fehlerbewertungen und der nachhaltigen Lösung wiederkehrender technischer Probleme.

Standards und technische Weiterentwicklung

  • Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Director Operations und angrenzenden Fachbereichen unsere technische Vision und Engineering-Roadmap maßgeblich mit und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für deinen Verantwortungsbereich ab.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass technische Erfahrungen aus Projekten, Inbetriebnahmen und Servicefällen strukturiert in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme einfließen.

  • Du bewertest neue technische Lösungen und Komponenten hinsichtlich ihrer Eignung für unsere Systeme und unterstützt bei deren Standardisierung.

Schnittstellen und Zusammenarbeit

  • Du definierst und koordinierst gemeinsam mit unserem Software- und Automation-Team die elektrotechnischen Anforderungen an Anlagenregelung, SCADA und unser Energiemanagementsystem AXOS.

  • Ausgeprägtes Systemverständnis und ein gutes Verständnis für die Schnittstellen zwischen Elektrotechnik, Konstruktion, Automatisierung, Anlagenregelung und Energiemanagementsystemen.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen projektbezogenen Dienstreisen entsprechend dem Projektfortschritt zu Projektstandorten, Kunden und Lieferanten zur Begleitung der Projektrealisierung, technischen Abstimmung und Bauüberwachung.

Führung

Du...

  • bringst Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung, Projektleitung oder Koordination technischer Teams mit und möchtest Verantwortung für die fachliche Entwicklung eines Engineering-Teams übernehmen.

  • bist fachlich souverän und kannst technische Entscheidungen strukturiert herbeiführen, verständlich begründen und im Team vertreten.

  • kommunizierst klar über Fachbereichsgrenzen hinweg und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Interessen zusammenführen.

  • verbindest hohe technische Qualitätsansprüche mit pragmatischem, wirtschaftlichem Denken und ausgeprägter Lösungsorientierung.

Organisatorische Einordnung

Die Position berichtet direkt an den Director Operations und übernimmt zunächst die fachliche Führung des Electrical-Engineering-Teams. Mit zunehmender Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben ist die Entwicklung zur disziplinarischen Teamleitung ausdrücklich vorgesehen.

title: Technical Programme Manager, Security Engineering (Risk)
descriptionHtml:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Wednesday 25th November 2026, end of day (UK Time).

About the team

As the models we test get more capable and the environments we run them in get more sensitive, we have to continue to be able to run evaluations of highly capable models under proper control and ensure that it remains governed well. Building that governance and keeping it fast is what lets AISI keep pace with the work in front of it.

The Security Engineering team keeps AISI's research platform, evaluation environments, and sensitive data secure, and runs the governance, risk, and compliance around them. We harden the environments evaluations run in, detect and respond to threats, and build the controls that let evaluations of highly capable models proceed safely. We work with research teams across AISI, with partners in frontier AI companies and government.

About the role

Rigorous safety governance and fast-moving research aren't mutually exclusive. AISI research involves working with highly capable AI models, often before they have been released to the public and often with lowered safeguards, to understand their true capabilities. That work has to be properly controlled, and someone has to build the processes and systems that help us make the call that it's safe to run without becoming a bottleneck. We're hiring a Technical Programme Manager in Security Engineering to own the AISI-wide governance mechanism that oversees these safety judgements, the controls research teams work under, and every edge case and escalation in between. You'll work with the team's engineers and the researchers whose work this governs.

What you'll own:

  • AISI-wide Governance Mechanism that oversees safety. Own the process, make clear what it approves and how, help people work through their requirements proactively, and keep decisions well-evidenced and moving.
  • The research/control interface. You'll own how research teams meet the security controls that apply to their work, and the defined path for handling the exceptions.
  • Programme architecture and delivery. You'll track the team's work and spot problems early, with enough visibility to stay in control.
  • Cross-government governance engagement. You'll represent AISI on governance and risk with partners across government, including the Cabinet Office, building the relationships, and turning departmental policy into AISI process.

Who we're looking for

Essential experience:

You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:

  • A track record with technical colleagues. You've delivered technical programmes somewhere similarly ambiguous. You can scope and structure an open-ended goal. Technical teams trust you.
  • Comfort at the frontier of AI. You don't have to be an ML researcher, but you need to hold your own in constant conversation with technical staff about the work, the strategy, and the risks. You should have a view on what's hard, what's speculative, what's blocked, and what "good" looks like.
  • High agency and ownership. You own outcomes, not activity.
  • Strong prioritisation under pressure. You can tell what actually matters day to day and quarter to quarter.

Desirable experience:

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience in security, risk, or GRC. A technical background with a genuine interest in security is ideal but not required.
  • Fluency in, or appetite for, modern productivity tools (coding agents, Linear, Slack) and AI tools as part of daily work.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. We care more about what you've broken, and how, than about certifications or job titles.

Selection process 

The interview process may vary from vacancy to vacancy, however, you should expect a typical process to include some technical proficiency tests, discussions with a cross-section of our team at AISI (including non-technical staff) and conversations with your team lead. The process will culminate in a conversation with members of the senior leadership team here at AISI.     

Candidates should expect to go through some or all of the following stages once an application has been submitted:   

  • Application - CV and a short cover note (max 500 words) explaining what draws you to this role and what you would bring.
  • Screening interview - Lightweight conversation on trajectory, motivation and fit.  
  • Work test - A take-home exercise designed to test programme management judgement in context. You will receive this after the screening interview. 
  • Technical interview - Discussion of your work test. 
  • Behavioural interview - Deeper dive on stakeholder management, prioritisation and team dynamics. 
  • Senior leadership interview (30 min) - Final conversation with AISI senior leadership.  

Security Clearance

Appointment is conditional on successfully completing UK Government SC clearance. Prior clearance is not required—we will sponsor and support you. You should normally have been resident in the UK for the past 5 years. More detail on clearance eligibility can be found on the UK Government website: National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK.   

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 
  • Excellent pension provision, with a choice between Partnership (no employee contributions required and up to 14.75% employer contributions) or Alpha, a valuable defined benefit scheme that provides a guaranteed, inflation-linked retirement income for life. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 
     

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £40,850 + Technical Allowance £24,150–£34,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £48,540 + Technical Allowance £36,460–£46,460)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £63,165 + Technical Allowance £41,835–£51,835)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £48,525–£58,525)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £68,525)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Use of AI tools in recruitment

We may use AI tools to help our hiring team review applications, for example by summarising application materials and helping us prioritise them against the published criteria. We do not use AI tools to find information about you from other sources, including online. People make every decision. We do not make solely automated decisions about candidates. Find out more, including your rights, in our recruitment privacy notice: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/careers/privacy-policy.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window). As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&I. You can see how we process this data here: Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK.

title: Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture.

In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale.

This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus.

  

Key Responsibilities

First Customer’s Point of Contact

  • Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries.

  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution.

  • Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently.

  • Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable.

  

Technical Support

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for:

    • GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures).

    • Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations).

    • Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters).

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems.

  • Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems

  • Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

  

Kubernetes & Containerization

  • Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on:

    • Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity).

  • Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors.

  • Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling.

  

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting).

  • Contribute to post-mortems with actionable follow-ups to prevent recurring incidents.

  • Train internal teams on best practices for compute infrastructure and debugging.

  • Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support team.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, technical support, or infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on compute-heavy environments (bare metal, cloud, HPC, or virtualization).

  • Deep Linux/Unix expertise:

    • Debugging kernel-level issues (e.g., OOM killer, I/O bottlenecks, CPU throttling).

    • Performance tuning (e.g., sysctl, ulimit, filesystem optimizations).

    • Networking troubleshooting (e.g., iptables, tcpdump, DNS, NFS, SSH).

    • Storage management (e.g., LVM, RAID, NVMe, GPU-local storage).

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience is mandatory:

    • Debugging pods, nodes, and clusters (e.g., kubectl describe, kubectl logs, crictl).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes).

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, containerd) and basic IaC awareness Proficiency with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

  • Basic scripting/automation skills (preferably Go, but Bash or Python are acceptable for ad-hoc tasks).

  • Experience with bare metal, virtualization, or HPC environments (e.g., Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast) is a strong plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for resolving issues efficiently and improving system reliability.

  • Ability to work in on-call rotations and handle high-pressure situations with a structured, calm approach.

  • Commitment to meeting tight SLAs for issue acknowledgment, triage, and first response.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

This senior leadership role will head a team responsible for the strategy and operational work behind all new initiatives across the UK and EU region, whether that's entering a new market, launching a new category or capability, or standing up a strategic partnership. You and your team will take complex operational problems from idea through launch, bringing together the teams, infrastructure, partnerships, and regulatory pathways required to make them real.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale.
